title: Divine Beast Vah Ruta
description: Related quest: [Divine Beast Vah Ruta](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248591) Contents: - Ancient Spring: 1st terminal room - In a chest, at the bottom of the right water bassin. - Silver Rupee: 2nd terminal room - Ride the water wheel to the top, then paraglide to the ledge where the water comes from. - Ancient Core: 3rd terminal room - As the giant wheel rotates, Stasis the stone slab above the chest. Open it before the Stasis runs out. - [Fire Arrow x10](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246021): 3rd terminal room - One of the blades of the water wheel is covered in Malice; shoot the eye underneath to access the chest on top. - Ancient Shaft: Trunk - From the 3rd terminal room, lower the trunk and paraglide to the end. - [Ice Arrow x10](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246022): Top of Ruta - Ride the trunk to its highest point, and shoot the eye to the right to free the chest to the left. Once completed, moves [here](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246015).

title: Divine Beast Vah Naboris
description: Related quest: [Divine Beast Vah Naboris](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248651) Contents: - Ancient Core:: Rear - In a chest, suspended by a rope. Stasis the chest, shoot the rope and Magnesis before it falls down. - Ancient Shaft: Middle cylinder - Shoot the eye to get rid of the Malice. Then, rotate the cylinder and paraglide to it. - [Knight's Bow](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246017): Middle cylinder - Opposite of the chest above; rotate the cylinder twice to access. - [Bomb Arrow x5](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246018): Back left leg - Access from the ramp outside. - Ancient Spring: Front right leg - Bomb the cracked window from the inside. - [Knight's Shield](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246019): Neck - Paraglide to the grated passageway up top. Then, rotate the cylinders to close the circuit at the top and open the grate. The chest is at the end of the trapped hallway. - Topaz: Back hump - At the top; access by climbing the front hump and taking the moving platform. Moves [here](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246020) once completed.

title: Divine Beast Vah Medoh
description: Related quest: [Divine Beast Vah Medoh](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248323) Contents: - Sapphire: End of the head - Shoot the eye just right of the chest to clear the path. - Ancient Core: Stomach - On top of a pillar. First, use Stasis to move the platorm left. Then, use Magnesis to bring the metal platform down. Finally, Stasis the moving platform again; the metal platform will block it and grant Link access. - [Bomb Arrow x5](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246024): Back right leg - On a platform, halfway up the beast. Drop down from the Guiding Stone room. - Ancient Shaft: Rear - On the lower level, hidden by Malice. Shoot the eye to reveal the chest. - [Ice Arrow x10](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246025): Left wing - Stuck on the ceiling with Malice; shoot the eye to release it. - [Knight's Bow](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246026): Left wing - On a tall platform. Tilt the Divine Beast right, then paraglide from the end of the wing. - [Knight's Claymore](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246027): Right wing - On a platform, at the end of the wing. Tilt the Divine Beast right, then paraglide from the Ancient Core platform to access. - Giant Ancient Core: End of the tail - Paraglide from the updrafts outside to access. Moves [here](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246028) once completed.

title: Divine Beast Vah Rudania
description: Related quest: [Divine Beast Vah Rudania](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248313) Contents: - [Dragonbone Boko Club](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246030): Lower abdomen, left side - Covered in Malice; shoot the eye to reveal it. - [Torch](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246031): Lower abdomen, right side - Covered in Malice; shoot the eye to reveal it. - [Ice Arrow x5](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246032): Lower abdomen - Stuck to the ceiling with Malice; shoot the eye to dislodge it. - [Knight's Bow](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246033): Upper abdomen, left side - Stuck to the wall with Malice; shoot the eye to dislodge it. - [Arrow x5](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246035): Upper abdomen, right side - Stuck to the wall with Malice; shoot the eye to dislodge it. - [Arrow x5](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246036): Upper abdomen, right side - Stuck to the wall with Malice; shoot the eye to dislodge it. - Ancient Core: Spine - Start on the right side of the torso. Tilt the Divine Beast left, then exit through the small opening and make your way towards the center. - [Knight's Bow](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246034): Upper abdomen - On top of a horizontal pillar; access by paragliding from the top. - Ancient Gear: Lower abdomen, right side - Stuck to the ceiling in the terminal room. Shoot a Fire Arrow at the leaves to dislodge it. - Silver Rupee: Underside - Start outside, by the head. Tilt the Divine Beast left to notice a Malice-covered platform. Drop down and jump in the opening to access.

title: Divine Beast Vah Rudania
description: Requirements: [Seek Out Impa](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248305) Steps: 1. Bludo, Boss of Goron City, wants to challenge the marauding Divine Beast Vah Rudania, but his backache is too severe. What's worse, Yunobo has yet to return from the [Abandoned North Mine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246308) with the painkillers he was sent to fetch. 2. You met Drak in the Abandoned North Mine, who told you that Yunobo left for the vault deep in its reaches. That's the last anyone has seen of Yunobo... Mount a search operation for Yunobo, who was headed for the [vault](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248315). 3. You met Yunobo in the Abandoned North Mine. Yunobo hurried back to Goron City to deliver the painkillers Bludo needs for his backache. You should go speak to [Bludo](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248312) to collect your reward. 4. Bludo thanked you for helping Yunobo. After taking the painkillers, Bludo was about to go challenge Divine Beast Vah Rudania, but then his back started hurting again. No one will be challenging the Divine Beast today, it seems. [Yunobo](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248318) has already gone ahead to the Bridge of Eldin, so you must meet him there to let him know about this change of plans. 5. You helped Yunobo fend off monsters at the Bridge of Eldin before telling him that Bludo's plan had been called off. You still need to get inside the Divine Beast somehow, though... The best way forward may be to [lower the Bridge of Eldin](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248319). 6. Yunobo used Daruk's Protection to act as a cannonball. The Bridge of Eldin has been lowered! All you need to do now is to cross the Bridge of Eldin and drive Divine Beast Vah Rudania into the crater. 7. Sentries now patrol Death Mountain to eliminate intruders. Avoid their notice as you lead Yunobo to the cannons to drive [Divine Beast Vah Rudania](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246029) into the crater. 8. Defeating Fireblight Ganon freed the spirit of Daruk, Champion of the Goron race. He has piloted the Divine Beast to the summit of Death Mountain in preparation for the assault on Ganon. Seeing this, a relieved Yunobo returned to his home in Goron City. You should go there and tell Bludo all that has happened. Next quest: [Free the Divine Beasts](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248311)

title: Horned Statue
description: Note: Doesn't work the same as the other statues. Instead, the Horned Statue will purchase either a Stamina Vessel or a Heart Container from Link for 100 Rupees, and sell either for 120 Rupees. Effectively, this allows Link to convert Stamina Vessels into Heart Containers, and vice-versa, for 20 Rupees each.

title: Tho Kayu Shrine
description: ## Tho Kayu's Blessing Location: Hidden in the ground; reveal it by lighting all 4 torches around the shrine, on the stone structures. Solution: 1. Walk to the monk to complete the trial. Treasure: 1. [Golden Bow](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246907) - In the middle of the room.

title: Bareeda Naag Shrine
description: ## Cannon Location: ?? Shrine quest: [The Ancient Rito Song](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247032) Solution: 1. Climb the ladder near the butt of the cannon, drop a Round Bomb in it and detonate it. Doing so will fire a cannon ball on a wooden plank, which will break and reveal the goal. 2. Repeat the process, this time aiming the detonation so the cannon ball hits the goal without touching the moving targets. 3. Walk through the gate to complete the shrine. Treasure: 1. [Swallow Bow](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247033) - Behind a wall of cracked blocks, just right of the entrance. 2. [Diamond](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247034) - Past the monk room, there is a second cannon. Repeat the walkthrough above to unlock a room with the chest.

title: Voo Lota Shrine
description: ## The Winding Route Location: ?? Shrine quest: [Recital at Warbler's Nest](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247041) Solution: 1. Climb the ladder, and walk to the switch. 2. Hit the switch, and immediately paraglide to Treasure Chest #1. 3. Glide along the air currents, stopping before the spiked walls, up to the locked monk. 4. Continue left of the monk, gliding along the air currents and riding the upwards fan. Continue gliding up to the chest with the Small Key. 5. Circle back to the monk the air currents, and unlock the door to complete the shrine. Treasure: 1. [Flameblade](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247046) - Face right as you hit the switch; you should see the chest on a lonely pillar to the right.

title: Keeha Yoog Shrine
description: ## Keeha Yoog's Blessing Location: ?? Shrine quest: [Cliffside Etchings](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246928) Solution: 1. Walk to the monk to complete the shrine. Treasure: 1. [Diamond](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246930) - In the middle of the room.

title: Sasa Kai Shrine
description: ## A Modest Test of Strength Location: ?? Shrine quest: [Sign of the Shadow](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246936) Solution: 1. Defeat the [Guardian Scout III](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246939) 2. Walk through the gate to complete the shrine. Treasure: 1. [Frostblade](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246938) - Just past the gate.

title: Sho Dantu Shrine
description: ## Two Bombs Location: Hidden in the ground; place a Luminous Stone on the pedestal to reveal it. Solution: 1. Blow up the boxes to the left to reveal a room. 2. Using the pillar, launch yourself in the air and land on the cage. 3. Drop a bomb on top of the cage, then drop down and detonate it. Doing so will open a room on the right side. 4. In the right room, place a bomb next to the switch behind the pillar. Then, climb on the lowered pillar. 5. Blow up the bomb to launch yourself in the air. Land on the cage, drop a bomb, drop down and detonate it. Doing so will open the far room. 6. Throw a Round Bomb in either launcher, then walk back to either pillar near the entrance to the room. 7. Detonate the bomb when as it flies above the cage to trigger the switch and complete the shrine. Treasure: 1. [Silver Rupee](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246926) - Behind the far column, in the left room.

title: Raqa Zunzo Shrine
description: ## Raqa Zunzo's Blessing Location: ?? Shrine quest: [The Undefeated Champion](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246897) Solution: 1. Walk to the monk to complete the shrine. Treasure: 1. [Radiant Shield](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246898) - In the middle of the room.

title: Toh Yahsa Shrine
description: ## Buried Secrets Location: ?? Shrine quest: [Trial of Thunder](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247007) Solution: 1. Using Bombs, destroy the many cracked blocks in the room. You should find a large metal block in front of the entrance, and a pressure plate behind the middle column. 2. Use the metal block to climb on the middle platform. 3. Using Magnesis, move the block around on the pressure plate. 4. Climb the ladder to complete the shrine. Treasure: 1. [Opal](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247013) - On top of a pillar, on the right. Knock it down using either arrows or the large metal block and Magnesis. 2. [Rubber Armor](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247012) - Just under the entrance; blow up the cracked blocks to access.

title: Mijah Rokee Shrine
description: ## A Modest Test of Strength Location: ?? Shrine quest: [Under a Red Moon](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247015) Solution: 1. Defeat the [Guardian Scout III](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247016) 2. Step through the gate to complete the shrine. Treasure: 1. [Frostblade](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247017) - Just past the gate.

title: Joloo Nah Shrine
description: ## Joloo Nah Apparatus Location: ?? Shrine quest: [Test of Will](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246932) Solution: 1. Rotate the cube so every face touches the power source. 2. Rotate the fans so they point diagonally. 3. Magnesis the metal cube on the pressure plate, on the right pillar. Then, paraglide to the pressure plate the metal cube was on. 4. Stasis the pressure plate, so it stays pressed as Link runs to the door. 5. Get Treasure Chest #2, then Magnesis it on the pressure plate. 6. Rotate the cube so all but one torch is lit. Then, Stasis the remaining fountain, and quickly light the final torch to complete the shrine. Treasure: 1. [Golden Claymore](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246934) - In the 2nd room, on a pillar to the left. Rotate the fans so they point diagonally, then glide along the wind current to the chest. 2. [Gerudo Spear](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246933) - In the 3rd room, on a wooden ledge on the central pillar. Rotate the cube so a lit torch stand on the front side (the one facing Link). Then, walk in front of the cube, and shoot an arrow through the torch into the wooden ledge, which will burn and drop the chest.

title: Mezza Lo Shrine
description: ## Ancient Trifecta Location: ?? Shrine quest: [The Crowned Beast](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246621) Solution: 1. Walk right, up the ramp towards the orange crystal. Drop a square bomb. 2. Hit the crystal until the pillar is near Link's platform. Step on the pillar. 3. Magnesis the metal block; doing so will rotate the platform. Drop the block on the lower floor. 4. Shoot the crystal to rotate it once more. Alternatively, Stasis the laser, since it will hit the crystal when it breaks out. 5. Magnesis the metal block on the pressure plate. 6. Step back on the pillar and detonate the bomb. This should rotate the pillar in front of the now open door. 7. Step through the door to complete the trial. Treasure: 1. [Thunderblade](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246622) - On a platform, to the left of the room. Link should be on this platform after step 3 of the above solution.

title: Kam Urog Shrine
description: ## Trial of Passage Location: ?? Shrine quest: [The Cursed Statue](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246635) Solution: 1. Move to the center of the wheel, in the way of the giant rotating blades. Move any spiked ball in the way with Magnesis. 2. Get 'scooped' by the blade, climbing on it when it gets horizontal enough. 3. Jump to the central gear, and wait for a blade to come down on the right side. 4. When the blade is horizontal, jump on it and run to the platform with the lamp post. 5. Jump on the gear to the next platform. 6. Wait for the smaller blade, which ends in a staircase, to come to the top. When it does, run on the staircase to complete the trial. Treasure: 1. [Opal](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246637) - On a ledge, halfway up the wheel. Get on the blade and paraglide to the ledge once Link is high enough. 2. [Soldier's Spear](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246636) - On the back of one of the rotating blades. From the Opal above, wait until that blade is down and paraglide to it.

title: Kah Yah Shrine
description: ## Quick Thinking Location: ?? Shrine quest: [A Fragmented Monument](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246666) Solution: 1. Go up the ramp on the left side, and pick up a barrel. 2. Move on the moving platform, staying on the left side. 3. After crossing the first wall, drop the barrel on the right side, and crouch to dodge the second wall. 4. Place the barrel on the pressure plate at the end to open the locked room on the left side. 5. Pick up the Small Key, and unlock the door in the center of the room to complete the shrine. Treasure: 1. [Knight's Claymore](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246670) - In a grated room, on the right side. Place a barrel on the moving platform, and guide it to the other side by shooting the switch to open the gates. Finally, place the barrel on the pressure plate to open the room.

Solution: 1. Walk to the monk to complete the shrine. Treasure: 1. [Royal Claymore](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247074) - In the middle of the room.

title: Maka Rah Shrine
description: ## Steady Thy Heart Location: In the mountain; access from a hole in the northeastern cliffside. Blow up the stone mounds to reveal a series of updrafts. Solution: 1. Light the torch on the left side of the door to open it. 2. Make your way across the rotating cylinder and step on the pressure plate. 3. Defeat all four Guardian Scouts. 4. Cryonis a pillar in front of the left-most pillar, then climb on it and step on the pressure plate to open the door. 5. Step on the pressure plate to lift the bars. Then, while hugging the left wall, move towards the boxed until the spiked ball rolls past. 6. Walk right and step on the pressure plate; doing so will lift the bars and release a spiked ball. Magnesis the ball on its way down. 7. Put the ball aside, Stasis it, then run up the ramp to the monk to complete the shrine. Treasure: 1. [Bomb Arrow x10](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247080) - On the right-most pillar, in the guardian room. Cryonis a pillar in front of it to access. 2. [Diamond](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247079) - Behind cracked blocks, atop the ramp with the spiked ball. Once at the top, turn around and blow the blocks, then Magnesis the chest. 3. [Ancient Core](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247078) - In an alcove, in the wall beyond the lava. Grab it using Magnesis.

title: Kah Okeo Shrine
description: ## Wind Guide Location: Under a stone slab; Stasis it, then hit it away to reveal the shrine. Solution: 1. Grab the [Korok Leaf](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247048) from the chest left. 2. Using the Korok Leaf, blow wind on the turbine to open the door. 3. Drop down and defeat the three sword-wielding Guardians, then climb back up. 4. Activate the turbine to spawn a floating platform. To control it, step on it and blow wind in the desired direction. Move to the back ledge. 5. Follow the path to the Guardian Scout I and defeat it. Then, blow up the cracked block behind. 6. Step on the launch pillar, and activate the turbine to launch Link into the air. Paraglide right to the structure. 7. In the structure, blow up the cracked block to reveal an air draft; ride it to the higher ledge. 8. Activate the turbine to spawn a floating platform. Guide it through the spiked blocks maze to the ledge. 9. Stand on the launch pillar and activate the turbine to launch Link on the higher platform. 10. Activate the turbine in the room to the left to spawn a floating explosive barrel. Guide it to one of the torches around the tall pillar to blow up the stone blocks and reveal an air draft. 11. Paraglide to the pillar, ride the air draft to the top and open the chest for the Small Key. 12. Paraglide to the archway flanked by blue torches. 13. Drop down and unlock the door to complete the shrine. Treasure: 1. [Gold Rupee](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247047) - On a pillar, in the back of the sword-wielding guardians room. After spawning the platform, guide it towards the back. 2. [Forest Dweller's Sword](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247050) - On a high platform, in the launch pillar room. After launching Link, paraglide left to the chest. 3. [Giant Ancient Core](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247049) - On a ledge, high near the second floating platform. Guide it right to the chest. 4. [Thunderspear](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247051) - In the final room before the monk. When you drop down, paraglide to the top left corner on the ledge.

title: Kema Zoos Shrine
description: ## A Delayed Puzzle Location: ?? Shrine quest: [The Silent Swordswomen](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246893) Solution: 1. Stasis the orb while it's flying from one launcher to the other, then break the Stasis. The orb will fall to the ground. - Alternatively, Stasis it while in a launcher. Wait for the launcher to extend, then break the Stasis so the orb gently rolls down. 2. Magnesis the orb near the pillar to the right of the central room to open it and complete the shrine. Treasure: 1. [Moonlight Scimitar](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246894) - In a caged room, to the far left. Magnesis the orb inside from the top to open it.

title: Hawa Koth Shrine
description: ## The Current Solution Location: ?? Solution: 1. Magnesis the metal blocks on each side of the black pillars, so they connect through their corners. 2. Magnesis the chained orb near the switch against the left wall to activate the elevator. 3. Defeat the Guardian Scouts guarding the bridge. 4. Magnesis the unchained orb across the bridge and on the pedestal on the left side. Be careful to avoid the switches on the bridge itself. 5. Reconnect the circuit: - Step on the pressure plate to send the blocks back; - Magnesis the metal block to the right side, in front of the 3rd block; - Step off the pressure plate, sending the first 2 blocks back in front; - Magnesis the metal block against the 2nd block _while_ stepping on the pressure plate, sending the 1st block back. The 2nd block should split in two; - Finally, release the Magnesis and step on the plate. Then, when the hole is aligned, Magnesis the block left; 6. Magnesis the large gear in the now open room to the locked monk room to complete the shrine. Treasure: 1. [Sapphire](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246902) - In the gear room. 2. [Gold Rupee](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246903) - In a secret alcove to the right of the bridge. Near the end, Magnesis the unchained orb on the high ledge to open the metal door leading to the chest. 3. [Ancient Core](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246904) - In the water pool, on the right side. Grab it with Magnesis.

title: Shada Naw Shrine
description: ## Red Giveaway Location: ?? Solution: 1. Drop down and look to the left of the ramp with Magnesis. Pull out the hidden block in the wall. 2. Grab the metal cube with Magnesis and place it on the pulled block. 3. Pick up the glowing orb, and walk to the glowing cubes near the entrance. 4. Throw the orb on the ramp; the ball should roll along the air currents, bump against the block and roll in the goal. Use Stasis on the moving platform when it completes the path. 5. Walk to the monk to complete the shrine. Treasure: 1. [Great Frostblade](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247068) - On a high ledge, near the back left corner. Grab it with Magnesis from the ledge under it.

title: Mozo Shenno Shrine

Shrine quest: [The Bird in the Mountains](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247064) Solution: 1. Defeat the [Guardian Scout IV](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247066). 2. Step through the gate to complete the shrine. Treasure: 1. [Diamond](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247067) - Just past the gate.

title: Sha Warvo Shrine
description: ## Path of Hidden Winds Location: ?? Solution: 1. Ride the three fans with the paraglider up to a moving platform, then climb the ladder. 2. Ride the fan, facing the dark column, then glide towards it. Circle around to find an alcove behind, with a fan inside. 3. Ride the fan and glide to the monk to complete the shrine. Treasure: 1. [Purple Rupee](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247036) - On a platform, left of the 2nd fan. Defeat the [Guardian Scout I](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247037) guarding it. 2. [Knight's Bow](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247035) - On a high platform, opposite the dark column. When riding the final fan, face right and glide to the chest.

title: Akh Va'quot Shrine
description: ## Windmills Location: ?? Solution: 1. Hit the switches to rotate the windmills so all turbines are spinning. In order: - 1st column (to the left): Both windmills should face right. - 3rd column: Face left. - 4th column: Top windmill should face down, bottom windmill should face left. - 5th column (to the right): Face up. 2. Walk through the gate to complete the shrine. Treasure: 1. [Ancient Core](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247028) - In a barred room, to the right of the entrance. Looking at the chest, turn right and shoot the switch across the water to activate the fan and open the door. 2. [Sapphire](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247030) - In a small alcove, behind the entrance. From Treasure Chest #1, Cryonis a pillar in the water, in front of the first depression against the right wall. Paraglide to it to access the chest. 3. [Feathered Spear](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247029) - In a small alcove, behind the entrance. From Treasure Chest #2, turn right and Cryonis a pillar in front of the next depression in the right wall. Paraglide to it to access the chest.

title: Tena Ko'sah Shrine
description: ## A Major Test of Strength Location: ?? Solution: 1. Defeat the [Guardian Scout IV](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247057) 2. title: Kuh Takkar Shrine
description: ## Melting Ice Hazard Location: Encased in ice; melt it with fire to access. Solution: 1. Pick up an ice cube; it must be carried all the way to the monk. 2. Walk around the first few fire pillars. 3. Throw the ice cube before the horizontal pillars, so it slides under them. 4. Jump on the sumberged metal block on the next platform. 5. Magnesis the metal block to block the fire pillars. 6. Throw the ice cube past the fire pillars, then Magnesis the block on the pillars. Make sure the fire stopped before walking under the cube. 7. Offer the ice to complete the shrine. Treasure: 1. [Frostblade](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246923) - In a column, behind fire pillars. After crossing the first horizontal fire pillars, Magnesis the metal block on the pillars to block them. Paraglide from up the ramp to access the chest.

title: Dako Tah Shrine
description: ## Electric Path Location: ?? Shrine quest: [The Eye of the Sandstorm](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246879) Solution: 1. Walk up the staircase, then turn right. 2. Defeat the [Guardian Scout I](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246881) and navigate the tight corridors. 3. Cross the gap on the moving platform, and Magnesis the power source. Hold it against the wire to cross the gap again. 4. Move up the ramp and power the elevator to the top. 5. Drop the power source in the middle of the room to destroy both Guardian Scouts. 6. Magnesis the metal block away. 7. Magnesis the power source past the metal block, on the upwards ramp, on the elevator and drop it on the pedestal. 8. Wait for the moving platform, then ride it to the monk to complete the shrine. Magnesis the metal block forward to clear the path. Treasure: 1. [Moonlight Scimitar](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246887) - When taking the first elevator, remove the power source halfway up. The chest is in a small alcove. 2. [Ancient Core](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246885) - In the room with two Guardian Scouts; drop down, and turn around. The chest is against the wall. 3. [Silver Rupee](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246884) - Past the first metal block, take the ramp down and hit the switch to activate the elevator. Ride it all the way down. 4. [Radiant Shield](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246886) - At the end of the shrine, behind the metal block. When the platform is at the monk, Magnesis the block backwards. Jump to the chest as the platform goes back.

title: Daqo Chisay Shrine
description: ## The Whole Picture Location: Just outside the North Entrance to Gerudo Town Solution: Follow the linked walkthrough for the solution and Treasure chest. Treasure: 1. [Thunderblade](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246891) - See walkthrough.

title: Rok Uwog Shrine
description: ## Power of Reach Location: ?? Solution: 1. Grab Treasure Chest #1. 2. Shoot an arrow through the torch just left of the entrance to burn away the leaves and reveal a passage. 3. Defeat the [Guardian Scout II](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247076). 4. Magnesis the metal block to drop the ramp. 5. Cross to the other side and defeat the other [Guardian Scout II](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247077). 6. Using the Drillshaft, destroy the barrels on the pressure plate to open the door and grab the Small Key. 7. Return near the entrance and open the locked door to complete the shrine. Treasure: 1. [Drillshaft](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247075) - On ledge, directly in front of the entrance. Grab it using Magnesis.

title: Gee Ha'rah Shrine
description: ## Tandem Location: Behind a stone door, at the base of the mountain. Pick up a [Snowball](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247089) and throw it down the left-most groove; the snowball should grow and roll down to the door. Solution: 1. Shoot the arrow supporting the boulder to push the piston and unlock the door. 2. At the crossroads, turn right into the next room. Stasis the boulder, then shoot both ropes so the boulder falls straight on the piston. 3. Walk through the gate to complete the shrine. Treasure: 1. [Diamond](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247090) - At the crossroads, turn left to see the chest beyond a barred room. Shoot the left rope supporting the boulder, so it falls on the piston and opens the door.

title: Goma Asaagh Shrine
description: ## A Major Test of Strength Location: Against the western side of the mountain, hidden behind ice pillars. Melt them to access the shrine. Solution: 1. Defeat the [Guardian Scout IV](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247070). 2. Step through the gate to complete the shrine. Treasure: 1. [Royal Claymore](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247071) - Just past the gate.

title: Lanno Kooh Shrine
description: ## Lanno Kooh's Blessing Location: Under the mountain; swim from the river flowing from [Hebra Falls](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246114) to access. Cryonis pillars as soon as possible to avoid freezing. Solution: 1. Walk to the monk to complete the shrine. Treasure: 1. [Gold Rupee](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247086) - In the middle of the room.

title: Dunba Taag Shrine
description: ## Build and Release Location: ?? Solution: 1. Stasis the rotating gear when the platform is horizontal so the ball rolls on it and pushes the piston. 2. Move to the far right corner of the next room. 3. Stasis the stone slab, then build momentum away (either by shooting arrows or throwing bombs). The slab should wall on the pressure plate and open the room beyond. 4. Walk in the room to complete the shrine. Treasure: 1. [Falcon Bow](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247088) - In the 2nd room, in a barred room left of the entrance. Blow up the stone blocks to reveal a hidden piston. Move in front of it, then turn around to see 4 barrels. Bring one to the edge, Stasis it and build momentum towards the piston. When done right, the barrel will press the piston and unlock the room. 2. [Great Thunderblade](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247087) - In a barred room, in the far left corner of the 2nd room. Stasis the seesaw so it stays straight. Then, step on the pressure plate as the boulder reaches the end of the ramp. This should launch the boulder on the seesaw and into the door. 11. description: ## Blue Flame Location: ?? Solution: 1. Magnesis the sliding spiked block up while moving past. 2. Turn left, and slide the blocks to form a staircase. 3. Alternatively, shoot an arrow to the unlit torch through the blue flame before walking to it. 5. Wait for the elevator to be low, then shoot an arrow through the blue flame to ignite it, triggering the staircase to complete. 6. Step on the pressure plate to lower the ramp, then Magnesis the spiked ball away and run up the ramp. 7. Defeat the four Guardian Scouts I, then light the torch on the left side of the gate. 8. Light the central torch in the next room. Then, Stasis one of the water spouts and light the torch in front of it. Light the final torch before the Stasis runs out. 9. Light the torch on the left. Then, light an arrow, and wait for both platform to align in the center to light both at the same time. 10. Ride the air currents to the second platform, then shoot through the flame to light the torch. 11. Light the torch atop the sliding block. Then, Stasis the water spout, and Magnesis the block to the other side. 12. Set fire to the leaf carpet to destroy the three Guardians, then carry the flame to the torch behind them. 13. Light a torch, step in the middle of the torches and perform a Charged Attack. This should light all the torches simultaneously and complete the shrine. Treasure: 1. [Royal Bow](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247147) - On a platform, left of the blue flame. Move the sliding blocks left to create a pathway. 2. [Great Flameblade](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247145) - In the four Guardians room, on the right side. 3. title: Shae Mo'sah Shrine

Place the barrel on the pressure plate. 3. Turn right and defeat all three Guardians. 4. Climb the ramp to the left to the next room. 5. Step on the pressure plate up the ramp to drop a lantern. 6. [Ice Arrow x10](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247137) - Past the second pressure plate; drop down on the chest.

Bring the three blocks near the scales. Jump on the one with the chest, along with one of the blocks. 5. Magnesis the other 2 blocks on the other plate. [Iron Sledgehammer](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247092) - Instead of walking to the monk, go in the left hallway and drop down to a new room. Stasis the orb, and build momentum towards the goal to open the room.

(Optional - See Treasure #2) Cryonis your way to the switch, leave a square bomb beside it, and make your way back. 3. Rotate the giant wheel a quarter of a turn. Then, _quickly_ swim across the pool, into the open archway. 4. Wait for the water level to drop, then Magnesis the barrel on the pressure plate. 5. Walk to the monk to complete the shrine. Treasure: 1. [Opal](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246649) - On a lower ledge, just right of the entrance. Drop down while the water level is down to access. 2. [Giant Boomerang](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246650) - On a high ledge, beside the monk. After completing the shrine, blow up your bomb to raise the water level, then Cryonis your way up the ledge.

Drop down in the pool and proceed to the next room to complete the shrine. Treasure: 1. [Silver Longsword](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246651) - After completing the shrine, return to the first room and drop down in the pool. The chest is in a secret room beyond the pool.

Step through the now open gate to complete the shrine. Treasure: 1. [Shield of the Mind's Eye](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246611) - In the open room, to the right of the starting point. 2. title: Ha Dahamar Shrine
description: ## The Water Guides Location: In the middle of the pond. To access, jump over the reeds using Cryonis. Solution: 1. Cryonis the water to create a pillar. 2. Cryonis the waterfall to create a horizontal pillar. 3. Walk halfway up the staircase. 4. Using Cryonis, guide the falling boulder into the goal. Create the following pillars: - After the first slope, so the boulder falls on the seesaw; - Under the left side of the seesaw, so it stays slanted to the right; - Between the seesaw and the goal, so the boulder doesn't fall in the hole. 5. Walk to the now open grate to complete the trial. Treasure: 1. [Purple Rupee](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246602) - On a ledge, high between the two waterfalls. title: Ree Dahee Shrine
description: ## Timing Is Critical Location: ?? Solution: 1. Step on the plate to slant the slate until the ball rolls into the goal. 2. Move across the gap using the moving platform. 3. Step on the plate to slant the slates; step off as the ball reaches about 2/3rds of the first slate. Adjust the timing as needed, so the ball ultimately rolls into the goal. 4. Move across the gap using the moving platform. 5. Step on the plate to slant the slate; step off as the ball reaches about 3/4rds of the slate, so it launches into the air and into the goal. Adjust the timing as needed. 6. Climb up the ramp to complete the shrine. Treasure: 1. [Climber's Bandanna](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246609) - On a platform, near the end of the shrine. From the final platform, look down towards the final goal to see a pair of barrels. Magnesis a barrel on the previous plate to slant the slate and grant access to the chest.

title: Toto Sah Shrine
description: ## Toto Sah Apparatus Location: In the cliffside, at water level; blow up the rocky wall to access. Solution: 1. Interact with the first terminal to rotate the floating pillar into a bridge. 2. Interact with the second terminal to rotate the stairs. From their starting position: - Press down to rotate them towards link, until the middle staircase is aligned with the others; - Press up to rotate them back straight. - Press left to rotate them and connect both platforms. 3. Interact with the third terminal to rotate the structure: - First, rotate until you have access to a chest; grab the _Small Key_ from it. - Then, rotate it until you connect both platforms. 4. Open the door with the _Small Key_ to complete the shrine. Treasure: 1. [Shield of the Mind's Eye](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246618) - On a side of the first floating pillar; rotate it until it faces up.

title: Shai Utoh Shrine
description: ## Halt the Tilt Location: Inside the mountain; blow up the cracked wall to the northwest to access. Solution: 1. Stasis the seesaw to prevent it from tilting, then climb up. 2. Tilt the seesaw to the right, then Stasis it and climb up the ledge. 3. Grab Treasure Chest #1 (see below). 4. Tilt the seesaw backwards (lower the far side), and Magnesis the chest to keep it in place. 5. Climb the seesaw, then Stasis the last seesaw straight. Cross it to complete the shrine. Treasure: 1. [Traveler's Sword](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246681) - From the ledge past the second seesaw, look back towards the right side of the seesaw. Grab the chest using Magnesis. 2. [Ancient Core](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246682) - On a high ledge, on the far end of the shrine. Tilt the third seesaw forwards (front side lowered) and step on it. Using Magnesis, grab Treasure Chest #1 and place it high above the seesaw. Drop it to launch Link high in the air, then paraglide to the chest.

[Ice Arrow x5](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246664) - Repeat the above process with the right launcher; the chest will fall from the wall, right of the launcher.

description: ## Pushing Power Location: ?? Solution: 1. Run up the slope, dodging the falling boulders. Stasis the laser to cross it safely. 2. Using Cryonis, guide the glowing ball into the goal. Then, light the torches by igniting your arrows. - Hit the switches in the following order (assuming Link is behind the cube, facing the torches): Right, Top, Back, Left, Front, Right, Top, Back, Top. [Silver Bow](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246640) - On a wooden ledge, high against the back wall to the right. Treasure: 1. [Diamond](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246643) - On top of a pillar, behind the column. Paraglide to it after dropping the metal block.

title: Ke'nai Shakah Shrine
description: ## A Modest Test of Strength Location: In the mountain; access by blowing up a cracked wall facing [Ulria Grotto](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246531). Solution: 1. Defeat the [Guardian Scout III](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247112) 2. Walk through the gate to complete the shrine. Treasure: 1. [Sapphire](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247111) - Just past the gate.

title: Tahno O'ah Shrine
description: ## Tahno O'ah's Blessing Location: ?? Shrine quest: [Secret of the Cedars](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246625) Solution: 1. Walk to the monk to complete the trial. Treasure: 1. [Climbing Boots](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246623) - In the center of the room.

title: Chaas Qeta Shrine
description: ## A Major Test of Strength Location: ?? Solution: 1. Defeat the [Guardian Scout IV](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246626) that appears in the middle of the room. 2. Walk through the now open grate to complete the trial. Treasure: 1. [Climbing Gear](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246627) - Just past the grate.

title: Yowaka Ita Shrine
description: ## EX Champions' Ballad DLC Quest Location: Forest of Spirits, near a fallen tree Solution: 1. Defeat the enemy camp to reveal it. 2. Brave several areas full of moving balls of various sizes and spikes. To avoid them, try running along the side and jumping up on a ledge and make your way to the catwalks on either side. 3. At the next area - you must use the provided metal bowl to collect the Shrine Orb as it tumbles out with other balls and objects along the side. 4. With the small orb back in the cup, don't dump it out yet - and head back to the first slope with the moving objects and extend the bowl carefully across to the other side and leave it so you can cross without having to worry about using Magnesis at the same time. Treasure: 1. Bomb Arrows 2. Phrenic Bow

title: Rohta Cigah Shrine
description: ## EX Champions' Ballad DLC Quest Location: North of the Eastern Abby in the Great Plateau region, South of the Great Plateau Tower - but you must defeat the enemy camp to reveal it. Solution: 1. Defeat the enemy camp to make it appear 2. Angle the platforms to build a walkway to the right side, you can climb up to the ledge to get a chest holding a Forest Dweller's Shield. 3. Avoid the spikes and use Statis to stop a conveyor belt to get across. 4. Glide between three giant spiked balls dangling from the roof. 5. Run from the spiked wall and survive the traps. Treasure: 1. Forest Dweller's Shield

title: Ruvo Korbah Shrine
description: ## EX Champions' Ballad DLC Quest Location: South of the Temple of Time, in the fields near the Old Man's hut - but you must defeat the enemy camp to reveal it. Solution: 1. A Major Test of Strength+ -- defeat the Guardian Treasure: 1. Bomb Arrows 2. Giant Ancient Core

title: Etsu Korima Shrine
description: ## EX Champions' Ballad DLC Quest Location: Below Mount Hylia to the North, just South above the River of the Dead - but you must defeat the enemy camp to reveal it. Solution: 1. Use weapons or Stasis to light up the dark and avoid the traps. 2. Defeat the three Guardian Scouts Treasure: 1. Gold Rupee

title: Kee Dafunia Shrine
description: ## EX Champion Mipha's Song DLC Quest Location: In the Lanayru Sea past Ankel Island and Knuckel Island - but you solve a puzzle to reveal it. Solution: 1. Head to Ulria Grotto to the Northeast of the Zora's Domain. Here you will find Tottika and Muzu, who will give you another clue to the trial. 2. Sit at the nearby campfire until morning, and look out over the ocean between Ankel Island and Knuckel Island. 3. Along the water, you can spot a faint glowing blue portal - glide down to it to reveal a new shrine in the water. 4. Melt ice blocks to solve the puzzles. Treasure: 1. Diamond

title: Sato Koda Shrine
description: ## EX Champion Mipha's Song DLC Quest Location: In Upland Zorana in the hills to the West of Toto Lake, found by climbing up the waterfall dams North of Zora's Domain - but you must clear out enemies to reveal it. Solution: 1. Inside, use Cryonis on the wall to influence where the ball goes. Treasure: 1. Giant Ancient Core

title: Mah Eliya Shrine
description: ## EX Champion Mipha's Song DLC Quest Location: Below Ploymus Mountain to the North, up past Mikau and Lulu Lake up the waterfall dams - but you must solve a puzzle to reveal it. Solution: 1. Use Magnesis to lift the left box up into the air, and while it falls, quickly pull out Cryonis and place a block below the falling box to keep it raised, and climb up to the platform. 2. Now that you have a ice block under the metal box on the left, you can either try lifting up the metal block further and use stasis before it falls - or use Magnesis on the small metal block to lift up the left block from underneath, next to the Cryonis block. 3. Now for the other side - get to the top of the left metal box and raise up the the right box as high as you can and use stasis before it drops. Treasure: 1. Royal Shield

title: Kamia Omuna Shrine
description: ## EX Champion Daruk's Song DLC Quest. Location: North of Lake Darman in the Northern reaches of Death Mountain - but you must defeat a mighty foe to reveal it. Solution: 1. Defeath the Igneo Talus 2. Insert a Round Remote Bomb and hit the switch to pan the cannon. As it passes over the target, explode your bomb to send the ball hurtling into the target - knocking it down and revealing a new target further back. 3. Aim the cannon at the chest to break the platform its on and send it crashing down below - and use Magnesis to pull the chest over that holds a Diamond. 4. Shoot the moving targets. Treasure: 1. Diamond

title: Sharo Lun Shrine
description: ## EX Champion Daruk's Song DLC Quest Location: Sharo Lun Shrine is located down the slopes East of Death Mountain across the Death Caldera from the volcano - but you must pass a trial to reveal it. Solution: 1. Warp to Divine Beast Vah Rudania and look along the rim to spot a glowing blue portal. 2. Follow the blue portals to open the shrine 3. Hold onto a safe part of the block when passing through the flames to beat this obstacle course. 4. Defeat the Guardian Scouts 5. To grab the perpetually falling chest, use Cryonis to make platforms you can jump to and get to more sturdy ground, then make a new ice platform to catch the chest holding a Great Flameblade. 6. Create new Cryonis platforms out of the waterfall to jump down to, and make stairs out of the ice to get to the Monk. Treasure: 1. Great Flameblade

title: Rinu Honika Shrine
description: ## EX Champion Daruk's Song DLC Quest Location: On the South side of the Darb Pond, South of the Bridge of Eldin - but you must pass a trial to reveal it. Solution: 1. Look along the Western banks of the pond to find a giant metal crate, and use Magnesis to carefully guide it to the ring. 2. From up on the clifftop, glide your way down and drop onto the metal box. 3. Avoid the flame jets. 4. Throw a Remote Bomb down and detonate to send the pillar down a notch and the bottom flame down below. 5. Use the metal block as a shield to strafe the other flames with the block in front of them. 6. Make a passage through the fire with metal blocks. 7. Flip the contraption upside-down until you see two E-shaped sections on each end, and angle them so that they face and block the flame jets on both sides. Treasure: 1. Stone Smasher

title: Shira Gomar Shrine
description: ## EX Champion Revali's Song DLC Quest Location: On the South side of Tanagar Canyon, located to the South of Hebra Tower, and just North of Upland Lindor - but you must complete a trial to reveal it. Solution: 1. Travel to the Hebra Tower and glide down Southwest until you reach this shelf - and look for the campfire of the Rito Guard Mazli. 2. If you wait at the camp until night, you'll spot the great dragon Dinraal around 1AM as he makes his way by from the East. Hop off and loose an arrow at his glowing horn, and the shrine will be revealed. 3. Stand a few paces back from the final wind gust and toss a bomb onto it and launch it up and detonate it when it's near the stones. 4. Up on the other side, you'll spot a tube to put a Round Remote Bomb in and it will fly off towards the far wall that you can also detonate - wait for the bomb to start dropping in height before blowing it up. 5. Ride the gusts up to the next level where two spinning gusts are on a middle platform, with two slots for bombs to shoot out. 6. Use Stasis to freeze the fan that triggers the gate to close - or Stasis the platform as it centers on the wall and wait for the fan to stop spinning. 7. Fly up into the next section, and up across the last few gusts to the Monk. Treasure: 1. Bomb Arrows

title: Kiah Toza Shrine
description: ## EX Champion Revali's Song DLC Quest Location: On the Eastern edges of the Pikida Stonegrove, East of the Hebra Peak and Summit - but you must complete a trial to reveal it. Solution: 1. Head up the mountain from Hebra Tower to find the slope - and a portal in the snow. 2. You'll need to start shield-surfing here and race down this long slope while sliding into all the portals that appear along the way. 3. Help the orb on its journey by moving down the path. Treasure: 1. Falcon Bow

title: Noe Rajee Shrine
description: ## EX Champion Revali's Song DLC Quest Location: At the Flight Range North of Dronoc's Path and the Rito Village - but you must complete a trial to reveal it. Solution: 1. Warp to the Sha Warvo Shrine and head into the Flight Range itself. The targets here have taken on a blue glow - but just hitting one while falling isn't enough. 2. Instead, float around until you have four targets in close range, and while in slow motion - shoot all four targets before you come out of focus, which may require some extra stamina. 3. Use wind gusts to glide and shoot switches. Treasure: 1. Shield of the Mind's Eye

title: Keive Tala Shrine
description: Note: This shrine can only be accessed when starting the EX Champion Urbosa's Song *DLC Quest.* Treasure: - Radiant Shield - After opening the shrine to the right of the shrine gate.

title: Takama Shiri Shrine
description: Note: This shrine can only be accessed when starting the EX Champion Urbosa's Song *DLC Quest.* Location: Takama Shiri Shrine is located in the Northwest corner of the Gerudo Desert - often obscured by sandstorms, Northwest of the West Barrens - but you must complete a trial to reveal it.

title: Kihiro Moh Shrine
description: ## EX Champion Urbosa's Song DLC Quest Location: At the end of the Yiga Clan Hideout hidden in the valley of the Gerudo Highlands, near the giant pit - but you must complete a trial to reveal it. Solution: 1. Travel to the Gerudo Tower and up and over the ridge to the arena where you fought Master Khoga - and the giant pit you sent him down. Down here, look for the twin adventurers Mina and Mils. 2. Climb up the ladder and cross the foortops to the second floor to grab the orb. 3. Toss the orb in the pit. 4. Place the colored orbs to match the number of torches on the wall: Blue - 4, Red -1, Yellow - 2, Green - 2. Treasure: 1. Thunderspear

description: After completing [Robbie's Research](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247205), Link can speak with Cherry to trade Rupees and ancient materials for ancient weaponry and equipment. Use the updrafts and the Paraglider to move around the Flight Range. Rewards: - Between 0 and 4 targets: Nothing - Between 5 and 9 targets: Red Rupee - Between 10 and 14 targets: Purple Rupee - Between 15 and 19 targets: Silver Rupee - 20 targets: Gold Rupee

title: Sand-Seal Racing
description: Requirements: Free the Divine Beast Vah Naboris How to start: Speak with [Shabonne](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246895) Cost: 50 Rupees (100 after completing The Undefeated Champion) Objective: Surfing on a shield tied to a Sand Seal, finish the race as fast as possible. Rewards: - While completing [The Undefeated Champion](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246897): Finish the race under 1:30.00 to gain a trophy and advance the quest. - After completing The Undefeated Champion: Beat your previous record for a Gold Rupee.

title: Gut Check Rock Challenge
description: Requirements: None How to start: Speak with [Bayge](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247163) Objective: Climb to the top of Gut Check Rock within 3 minutes, gathering enough Rupees along the way. In addition to the reward, Link may keep the gathered Rupees on a success. _Gut Check Challenge:_ - Cost: 50 Rupees - Rupee goal: 100 Rupees - Reward: Rushroom _Super Gut Check Challenge:_ - Cost: 100 Rupees - Rupee goal: 300 Rupees - Reward: Endura Shroom

title: All or Nothing
description: Requirements: None How to start: Speak with [Cloyne](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247434) Cost: Depends on the level Objective: Pay the cost, then open one of the three chests that appear. One will contain the prize, while the other two contain a Green Rupee. Cost / Reward: - Bet 10 Rupees for a Red Rupee; - Bet 50 Rupees for a Silver Rupee; - Bet 100 Rupees for a Gold Rupee;

title: Obstacle Course
description: Requirements: None How to start: Speak with [Blynne](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247464) Cost: 20 Rupees Objective: Jump over the 10 obstacles and come back to the stable as fast as possible. Rewards: - [Extravagant Bridle](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247466): Completion under 1:30.00 - [Extravagant Saddle](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247467): Completion under 1:15.00

title: Selmie's Shield-Surfing
description: Requirements: Have a shield equipped How to start: Speak with [Selmie](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248294) Cost: 20 Rupees Objective: Race down the slope as fast as possible. Rewards: _Beginner's Course_: - Over 1:00.00: Nothing - 1:00.00 and under: Access to the Advanced Course _Advanced Course_: Each reward can only be obtained once. - Over 4:00.00: Nothing - 3:20.01 to 4:00.00: [Wooden Shield](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=245386) - 3:05.01 to 3:20.00: [Hunter's Shield](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=245513) - 2:50.01 to 3:05.00: [Emblazoned Shield](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=245521) - 2:35.01 to 2:50.00: [Fisherman's Shield](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=245515) - 2:20.01 to 2:35.00: [Traveler's Shield](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=245526) - 2:05.01 to 2:20.00: [Kite Shield](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=245550) - 1:50.01 to 2:05.00: [Soldier's Shield](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=245404) - 1:35.01 to 1:50.00: [Knight's Shield](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=245416) - 1:35.00 and under: [Royal Shield](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=245507)

title: Snowling
description: Requirements: None How to start: Speak with [Pondo](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248297) Cost: 20 Rupees Objective: By rolling a snowball down the hill, knock down as many pins as possible in 2 tries. title: Bird-Man Research Study

title: 001 Skilled Assembly Voice Memory
description: The 001 Skilled Assembly Voice Memory can be found in Hyrule Castle, located right outside the front gates, north of Castle Town Ruins.

title: 002 Dreading Banquets Voice Memory
description: The 002 Dreading Banquets Voice Memory can be found inside Hyrule Castle, on the southeast side of the castle, inside a room called the Dining Hall.

title: 003 Down Below... Voice Memory
description: The 003 Down Below... Voice Memory can be found at Hyrule Castle, on a balcony overlooking the front gates on the south side of the castle.

title: 004 The Protective Gate Voice Memory
description: The 004 The Protective Gate Voice Memory can be found on the path up to Hyrule Castle, inside a building called the First Gatehouse.

title: 005 A Stream of Support Voice Memory
description: The 005 A Stream of Support Voice Memory can be found inside Hyrule Castle, specifically in the Guards' Chamber on the southwest side of the castle. By stepping onto the landing on the first level of this chamber, you can trigger the Voice Memory.

title: 006 Rusted Prison Voice Memory
description: The 006 Rusted Prison Voice Memory can be found inside Hyrule Castle, within the Lockup section on the northwest side of the castle.

title: 007 Busy Days Voice Memory
description: The 007 Busy Days Voice Memory can be found inside Hyrule Castle, right beside the Saas Ko'sah Shrine on the northeast side of the castle. You cant rigger the memory by standing right beside the unlit brazier across from the shrine.

title: 008 A Princess's Secret Voice Memory
description: The 008 A Princess's Secret Voice Memory can be found inside Hyrule Castle, on the first floor of the Library. You can find the Library on the northeast side of the castle.

title: 009 Two Thrones Voice Memory
description: The 009 Two Thrones Voice Memory can be found inside Hyrule Castle, by the two thrones on the balcony overlooking the Sanctum.

title: 010 The Bells That Tolls Voice Memory
description: The 010 The Bells That Tolls Voice Memory can be found inside Hyrule Castle, inside the bell tower at the very top of the castle.

title: 011 Sleepless Nights Voice Memory
description: The 011 Sleepless Nights Voice Memory can be found inside Hyrule Castle, inside Princess Zelda's Rooms on the west side of Hyrule Castle. Stand beside Zelda's collapsed bed to trigger this voice memory.

title: 012 The Princess's Refuge Voice Memory
description: The 012 The Princess's Refuge Voice Memory can be found inside Hyrule Castle, inside the tower on the west side of the castle called Princess Zelda's Study.

title: 013 Memories at the Gazebo Voice Memory
description: The 013 Memories at the Gazebo Voice Memory can be found outside Hyrule Castle, near the ruins of a stone gazebo on the west side of the castle.

title: 014 Barred from the Prison Voice Memory
description: The 014 Barred from the Prison Voice Memory can be found southwest of Hyrule Castle, on the Moat Bridge that leads from Castle Town to the Castle Town Prison west of the castle.

title: 015 Origin of the Name Voice Memory
description: The 015 Origin of the Name Voice Memory can be found in the Seres Scablands, and area found in the far west section of Hyrule Ridge (the eastern chunk of Central Hyrule that borders Tabantha).

title: 016 Open Gate Voice Memory
description: The 016 Open Gate Voice Memory can be found in the Royal Ancient Lab Ruins in North Hyrule Plain, in the western area of Central Hyrule.

title: 017 Specialties Voice Memory
description: The 017 Specialties Voice Memory can be found in the Salari Plains, a flat area in the north of the Lindor's Brow ridge north of the Ridgeland Shiekah Tower. The ruins found here are called the Maritta Exchange.

title: 018 Solitary Moving Stable Voice Memory
description: The 018 Solitary Moving Stable Voice Memory can be found just outside of the Serenne Stable in Hyrule Ridge, the large western area between Hyrule Field and the Tanagar Canyon.

title: 019 Over Capacity Voice Memory
description: The 019 Over Capacity Voice Memory can be found outside the Snowfield Stable in South Tabantha Snowfield. Standing just outside the stable, where you can talk to the innkeep about boarding your horse, will trigger this memory.

title: 020 Village Blanketed by Snow Voice Memory
description: The 020 Village Blanketed by Snow Voice Memory can be found on the southern side of the Tabantha Village Ruins, in Tabantha region.

title: 021 Unwavering Devotion Voice Memory
description: The 021 Unwavering Devotion Voice Memory can be found in the Hebra Mountains, just outside the Rito Stable to the east of Rito Village itself. Standing in front of the Stable by the innkeep will trigger this memory.

title: 022 Divine Beast of Wind Voice Memory
description: The 022 Divine Beast of Wind Voice Memory can be found just outside Rito Village in the Hebra Mountains. Stepping up to the very first bridge which spans across towards the Rito Village from the eastern side will trigger this memory.

title: 023 Medoh's Perch Voice Memory
description: The 023 Medoh's Perch Voice Memory can be found in Rito Village in the Hebra Mountains. To trigger this memory, you will need to stand on the third island on the path that leads east to west into Rito Village.

title: 024 Soaring Village Voice Memory
description: The 024 Soaring Village Voice Memory can be found in Rito Village in the Hebra Mountains. To trigger this memory, you must follow the path across the islands to the Rito Village entrance at the base of the giant pillar. Standing beneath the colorful archway will trigger the memory.

title: 025 Feathered Traditions Voice Memory
description: The 025 Feathered Traditions Voice Memory can be found in Rito Village in the Hebra Mountains. To trigger this memory, climb up the Rito Village staircases until you see the armor shop on the right-hand side. The flags hanging outside are marked by shirt icons. Step inside the Rito Village armor shop.

title: 026 Masterful Performance Voice Memory
description: The 026 Masterful Performance Voice Memory can be found in Rito Village in the Hebra Mountains. To trigger this memory, climb up the Rito Village staircases until you see the small building to the right with a lit cooking pot. You can find this building just one level above the armor shop, midway up the village.

title: 027 Iron-Clad Force Voice Memory
description: The 027 Iron-Clad Force Voice Memory can be found in Rito Village in the Hebra Mountains. To trigger this memory, climb up the Rito Village staircases towards the very top of the village. You will find the location inside the building where the Rito elder resides.

title: 028 Bedraggled Wings Voice Memory
description: The 028 Bedraggled Wings Voice Memory can be found in Hebra, in a location north of Rito Village and Lake Totori called Drocnoc's Pass. This is also where you will find the Flight Range, a strange, circular chasm in the mountains that generates its own updraft of wind.

title: 029 Secret Rito Spring Voice Memory
description: The 029 Secret Rito Spring Voice Memory can be found in the far north of Hebra, in a location called Goflam's Secret Hot Springs on your map. Reaching this hot spring will prove difficult, as you'll need to scale the Hebra Mountains to get there.

title: 030 The Scar's Story Voice Memory
description: The 030 The Scar's Story Voice Memory can be found in the far north of Hebra, at the very foot of Hebra Peak (the peak on the eastern side of the Hebra Mountains). If you stand beneath the Hebra Peak, looking towards a lone lean-to tent and ice block, you will trigger this memory.

title: 031 Forgotten Temple Voice Memory
description: The 031 Forgotten Temple Voice Memory can be found inside the Forgotten Temple in the far north side of Tanagar Canyon. You can find this canyon northwest of Great Hyrule Forest. Standing at the steps leading up to the giant Goddess Statue at the very back of the temple will trigger this memory.

title: 032 Slumbering Ruins Voice Memory
description: The 032 Slumbering Ruins Voice Memory can be found just north of the Great Hyrule Forest, on the western bridge leading into the Typhlo Ruins.

title: 033 An Atypical Request Voice Memory
description: The 033 An Atypical Request Voice Memory can be found at the Foothill Stable in Eldin. You can find this stable along the path north of Lanayru Wetlands, headings towards Death Mountain.

Weapon Type: Two-Handed Attack Power: 55 Durability: 50 Other effect: +50% damage against Guardian-type enemies Scales into: None

title: Ancient Spear
description: Location: Sold by the [Akkala Ancient Tech Lab](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247202) for 1,000 Rupees, 15x Ancient Gear, 5x Ancient Shaft and 2x Ancient Core. Weapon Type: Spear Attack Power: 30 Durability: 50 Other effect: +50% damage against Guardian-type enemies Scales into: None

title: Ancient Bow
description: Location: Sold by the [Akkala Ancient Tech Lab](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247202) for 1,000 Rupees, 15x Ancient Spring, 10x Ancient Gear and 1x Giant Ancient Core. Weapon Type: Bow Attack Power: 44 Durability: 120 Other effect: +50% damage against Guardian-type enemies Scales into: None

title: Wooden Mop
description: Location: Sold by [Kilton](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247441) for 19 Mons. Weapon Type: Spear Attack Power: 5 Durability: 8 Other effect: None Scales into: None

title: Spring-Loaded Hammer
description: Location: Sold by by [Kilton](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247441) for 199 Mons, after defeating 1 Divine Beast. Weapon Type: One-Handed Attack Power: 1 Durability: 80 Other effect: Knockback - On the 4th consecutive hit, knocks the enemy away very far. Scales into: None

title: Traveller's Sword
description: Location: Inside a Bush Weapon Type: One-Handed Attack Power: 5 Durability: 20 Other effect: None Scales into: Soldier's Broadsword; Knight's Broadsword; Royal Broadsword

title: Follow the Sheikah Slate
description: Requirements: None Steps: 1. From out of nowhere, you hear a woman's voice speak to you... She instructs you to head to the [marker](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246222) displayed on the Sheikah Slate. Next quest: [The Isolated Plateau](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248304)

title: The Isolated Plateau
description: Requirements: [Follow the Sheikah Slate](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248303) Steps: 1. After your descent from the tower, the old man told you that the kingdom of Hyrule was destroyed 100 years ago by Calamity Ganon. You heard a voice coming from Hyrule Castle, but you cannot reach it unless you leave the plateau using the paraglider. The old man said that he will give you the paraglider in exchange for a treasure that lies within a [hidden location](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225212) somewhere... 2. The Old Man explained that there are a total of four Shrines on the plateau. He said that he will give you the Paraglider once you have acquired the Spirit Orb from all the of the Shrines. He told you to survey the plateau from the top of the tower to find the remaining shrines ([Keh Namut Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225203), [Ja Baij Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225211), [Owa Daim Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225214)). He also pointed out that you can use your Sheikah Slate if you need to travel quickly. 3. After you acquired the Spirit Orbs from the shrines, the old man told you that he'll be waiting in [the place centered amid the four shrines](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246220), before mysteriously disappearing... Next quest: - [Seek Out Impa](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248305) - [Destroy Ganon](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248307)

title: Seek Out Impa
description: Requirements: [The Isolated Plateau](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248304) Steps: 1. You were tasked with going to Kakariko Village to speak with [Impa](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248306), who will give you more details on your quest. Descend from the Great Plateau and head east beyond the Dueling Peaks, then follow the road to the north. The blinking dot on your Sheikah Slate's map will guide the way. Next quest: - [Locked Mementos](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248308) - [Free the Divine Beasts](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248311)

title: Destroy Ganon
description: Requirements: [The Isolated Plateau](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248304) Steps: 1. The ghost of King Rhoam told you that Hyrule is on the brink of annihilation. Princess Zelda is currently fighting to contain Calamity Ganon inside Hyrule Castle, but her power cannot keep him at bay forever. Eventually, Ganon will regain his full strength and destroy the world. Your ultimate task is to aid Princess Zelda in defeating Ganon before that can happen. Next quest: Congratulations, you have completed Breath of the Wild!

title: Locked Mementos
description: Requirements: [Seek Out Impa](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248305) Steps: 1. According to Impa, the Sheikah Slate that Zelda left to guide you is incomplete. The director at the Hateno Ancient Tech Lab in Hateno Village may know a way to restore the Sheikah Slate's missing components. Use the map to find the location of the [Hateno Ancient Tech Lab](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247203) and its [director](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247204). 2. The Hateno Ancient Tech Lab's director can't fix the Sheikah Slate until the Guidance Stone is operational again. The only way to power the Guidance Stone is to light the furnace on the outer wall of the tech lab with a blue flame. Carry the blue flame from the [ancient furnace](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248309) in Hateno Village to the tech lab, and use it to light the lab's furnace. 3. The blue flame in the furnace is now powering the Hateno Ancient Tech Lab's Guidance Stone. Report to the director so that she can repair your Sheikah Slate. 4. Purah has fixed the Sheikah Slate, restoring the last of its basic runes from 100 years ago. Snap an image of Purah using the Camera rune! 5. You proved the Camera works again by capturing an image of Purah! According to Purah, the album already has pictures from the past in it. Where could these have come from? [Impa](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248306) in Kakariko Village may have the answer. Next quest: - [Find the Fairy Fountain](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248654) - [Captured Memories](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248310)

title: Captured Memories
description: Requirements: [Locked Mementos](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248308) Steps: 1. Princess Zelda left behind an album with twelve pictures in it. Traveling to the places shown in these pictures may help you to regain your memories of the princess. _Editor's Note:_ Use the sidebar to find the 12 locations in question. [Zelda's Awakening](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=243834) is unavailable until you first capture the other 12 memories. 2. You've found all of the locations in the pictures! Go and report the news to [Impa](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248306) in Kakariko Village. 3. The location of the final memory is hanging on the wall of Impa's home. What memory of your past with Princess Zelda awaits you there? Next quest: None

title: Free the Divine Beasts
description: Requirements: [Seek Out Impa](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248305) Steps: 1. There are four Divine Beasts that must be freed. Each race's elder should have more details: - _Editor's Note:_ Complete each of the following quests to progress this quest. - The [Divine Beast Vah Rudania](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248313), piloted by Daruk of the Gorons - The [Divine Beast Vah Medoh](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248323), piloted by Revali of the Rito - The [Divine Beast Vah Ruta](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248591), piloted by Mipha of the Zora (requires [Reach Zora's Domain](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248588)) - The [Divine Beast Vah Naboris](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248651), piloted by Urbosa of the Gerudo (requires [Forbidden City Entry](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248641)) 2. You've reclaimed the four Divine Beasts by defeating the four Ganon phantoms haunting them. You should let [Impa](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248306) know of your success. Next quest: [Destroy Ganon](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248307)

title: Divine Beast Vah Medoh
description: Requirements: [Seek Out Impa](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248305) Steps: 1. Kaneli, elder of Rito Village, wants you to help a local soldier named Teba. You offered your assistance, but first you must find the soldier. Teba's wife [Saki](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248321) may know where he is. Ask around Rito Village to gather more information. 2. You found Saki and asked where Teba went. It sounds like he headed for the Flight Range. Search the Flight Range for [Teba](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248322). 3. You found Teba at the Flight Range, but he has no intention of returning to the village before Divine Beast Vah Medoh has been appeased. He intends to appease the Divine Beast himself. You had better help him out. 4. Teba won't let you anywhere near Divine Beast Vah Medoh unless you can at least hit the targets at the Flight Range. If you catch an updraft with your paraglider, it'll carry you high into the sky. Use this technique to destroy five targets with arrows within the time limit to prove yourself to Teba. 5. You proved your mettle by hitting the targets at the Flight Range. When it comes time to battle Divine Beast Vah Medoh, Teba will draw the focus of its attacks so you can focus on destroying its cannons. Teba will carry you into the sky where Divine Beast Vah Medoh awaits. 6. The battle with Divine Beast Vah Medoh has begun! Use the paraglider to launch into the air for a good vantage point, and then take out all the cannons with your bomb arrows. But be careful—if you get too close, you'll run into the Divine Beast's barrier! 7. You destroyed all of Divine Beast Vah Medoh's cannons and landed on its back, but Teba suffered injuries and had to retreat. You must finish what you both started.
