Enter [Divine Beast Vah Medoh](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246023) on your own to stop it once and for all! 8. You defeated Windblight Ganon, which had infested the insides of Divine Beast Vah Medoh. The Divine Beast has been enshrined at the highest point of Rito Village, and moreover, it looks like Teba was able to safely return to Rito Village. Go report to [Kaneli](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248320). Next quest: [Free the Divine Beasts](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248311)

title: The Hero's Sword
description: Requirements: Reach the [Master Sword](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246013) through the Lost Woods, and try to pull it. Steps: 1. Through the Lost Woods and deep within the Korok Forest sleeps the sword that seals the darkness, a weapon said to be capable of striking down the Calamity. Though you came to claim the sword, the Deku Tree told you the blade would test you... Although you wielded it 100 years ago, can you pull the sword out in your current state? - Try to pull the sword with at least 13 Heart Containers to complete the quest. Next quest: None

title: Reach Zora's Domain
description: Requirements: [Seek Out Impa](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248305) Steps: 1. [Sidon](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248589), prince of the Zora, invited you to come to [Zora's Domain](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247376) He warned you that owing to the heavy rains, the rocks along the path are dangerously slippery. 2. You arrived at Zora's Domain. The next step is to visit [King Dorephan](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248590) in the throne room on the top floor. Next quest: [Divine Beast Vah Ruta](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248591)

title: Divine Beast Vah Ruta
description: Requirements: [Reach Zora's Domain](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248588) Steps: 1. You have been asked to help appease Vah Ruta, Divine Beast of Water. The task will require a great many shock arrows. Find [Muzu](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248592) in Zora's Domain square to find out where to get them. 2. You asked Muzu where to get the arrows, but he refuses to help because you're a Hylian. However, he seems willing to cooperate if you can somehow prove that you were special to Mipha. You have the [Zora Armor](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248594) that Mipha made for you. Maybe it will be proof enough. - Wear the Zora Armor while talking to him. 3. According to Muzu, you can get shock arrows from Ploymus Mountain. Wearing the Zora armor allows you to swim up waterfalls, so swimming up the waterfall east of Zora's Domain will make for a nice shortcut. First, you'll need to collect 20 shock arrows. - _Editor's Note:_ Defeating the [Lynel](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248593) has a chance to drop Shock Arrows. Otherwise, there are plenty scattered across the mountain; use the 'Arrow Chest' category for the exact locations. 4. You collected the 20 shock arrows you'll need to face the Divine Beast. Now head to East Reservoir Lake and meet with [Sidon](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248595). The lake is directly below Shatterback Point, the peak of Ploymus Mountain. 5. You met up with Sidon at East Reservoir Lake and are ready to put those shock arrows to use. Their electricity can activate the devices on [Divine Beast Vah Ruta](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246014)'s back. 6. You activated the devices on 's back, halting its barrage. Now's your chance. Head inside and take back the Divine Beast! 7. You defeated Waterblight Ganon, which had taken control of Divine Beast Vah Ruta. Divine Beast Vah Ruta has been enshrined to the west of Lanayru Great Spring. Return to Zora's Domain and report to King Dorephan. Next quest: [Free the Divine Beasts](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248311)

title: Forbidden City Entry
description: Requirements: [Seek Out Impa](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248305) Steps: 1. You heard of [a man](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248642) at the Kara Kara Bazaar who found a way to sneak into Gerudo Town, a place men are forbidden from entering. Try and locate some people who know his whereabouts. - Purchase the [Gerudo Veil](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248648), [Gerudo Top](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248649) and [Gerudo Sirwal](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248650) for 600 Rupees as a set. 2. You were able to find the man who snuck into Gerudo Town, and you got a Gerudo outfit from him. Put that on and you'll be able to pass for a woman while you're wearing it... Next quest: [Divine Beast Vah Naboris](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248651)

title: Divine Beast Vah Naboris
description: Requirements: [Forbidden City Entry](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248641) Steps: 1. The leader of the Gerudo, Lady [Riju](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247297), asked for your help in conquering Divine Beast Vah Naboris. Before you can confront the Divine Beast, the Gerudo need help recovering the chief's heriloom, which has been stolen. Captain [Teake](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248652) in the solders' barracks has the latest information on the thieves. 2. After speaking with Captain Teake, you learned that the thieves are hiding out in Karusa Valley, but the hideout itself has not been scouted by any of the soldiers. Gather additional information from the soldiers, and then head for the [thieves' hideout](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246588). 3. You've arrived in the thieves' hideout! You can sense many people waiting within—you would be at a disadvantage if a fight were to break out. Sneak into the hideout, and recover the [Gerudo chief's heirloom](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=244844). 4. You retrieved the chief's heirloom from the thieves' leader! It's time to head back to Gerudo Town and return the heirloom to Riju! 5. At last you are ready to take on the Divine Beast Vah Naboris. Head for the lookout post where [Riju](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248653) is waiting for you. Riju has told you that a fight with the [Divine Beast](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246016) will go much more smoothly for one who knows how to sand-seal surf. 6. You defeated the Thunderblight Ganon lurking deep within the Divine Beast Vah Naboris! Urbosa's Divine Beast Vah Naboris has taken up a position in the eastern region of the Gerudo Desert. Make your way back to Gerudo Town, and report to the chief of the Gerudo, Riju! Next quest: [Free the Divine Beasts](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248311)

title: Find the Fairy Fountain
description: Requirements: [Locked Mementos](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248308) Steps: 1. [Pikango](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=237724) really wants to see the entrancing [Great Fairy Fountain](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246338) behind Kakariko Village, but all of his efforts to search for it have been stymied. If you find the fountain, surely Pikango would appreciate proof of its location. Next quest: [Captured Memories](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248310)

title: The Shrine of Resurrection
description: When the game begins, a distant voice will bid Link to open his eyes. Link will awaken in a mysterious chamber from a platform that drains as he wakes. Inspecting the pedestal, you'll find the Sheikah Slate. This important tool has a lot of features that you'll become accustomed to over time.

title: EX The Champions' Ballad
description: Requirements: The Champions' Ballad DLC , completed each of the Divine Beasts and defeated the Blight Ganons inside Steps: 1. Once you have completed these main quests, Zelda will speak to you, and urge you to return to the Shrine of Resurrection where you first began the game, and place the Sheikah Slate back onto the pedestal where you initially found it. 2. Get the One-Hit Obliterator and complete the trials at the four target destinations

title: EX Champion Mipha's Song
description: Requirements: The Champions' Ballad DLC, completed each of the Divine Beasts and defeated the Blight Ganons inside. Steps: 1. Cross the Rutala Dam and climb up to find Kass already at the pedestal. 2. On the pedestal, the three obelisks reveal map locations of the shrines you must uncover and complete - which you can do in any order. All three of them are in the nearby area of the Lanayru Region.

title: EX Champion Daruk's Song
description: Requirements: The Champions' Ballad DLC, completed each of the Divine Beasts and defeated the Blight Ganons inside. Steps: 1. Talk to Kass 2. On the pedestal, the three obelisks reveal map locations of the shrines you must uncover and complete - which you can do in any order. All three of them are in the nearby area of the Eldin Region.

title: EX Champion Revali's Song
description: Requirements: The Champions' Ballad DLC, completed each of the Divine Beasts and defeated the Blight Ganons inside. Steps: 1. Cross Lake Totori and climb up to find Kass already at the pedestal - who is trying to complete the song of his old teacher. 2. On the pedestal, the three obelisks reveal map locations of the shrines you must uncover and complete - which you can do in any order. All three of them are in the nearby area of the Tabantha and Hebra Regions.

title: EX Champion Urbosa's Song
description: Requirements: The Champions' Ballad DLC, completed each of the Divine Beasts and defeated the Blight Ganons inside. Steps: 1. You can find the newly arisen pedestal at East Gerudo Mesa, located not far South from the Divine Beast Naboris and up the mountains to the North of Suma Sahma Shrine. 2. On the pedestal, the three obelisks reveal map locations of the shrines you must uncover and complete - which you can do in any order. All three of them are in the nearby area of the Wasteland and Gerudo Highlands Region.

title: The Divine Trial
description: Requirements: Champions' Ballad DLC, completed each of the Divine Beasts and defeated the Blight Ganons inside. Upon entering the Shrine of Resurrection, place the Sheikah Slate once more in the slot, and a surprise elevator will descend the entire shrine down into a labyrinth designed by the Monk Maz Koshia - who has tasked you with solving this last giant test.

title: Revali's Flap
description: This memory - not attached to Princess Zelda - can be obtained during the [Divine Beast Vah Medoh](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248323) quest. After speaking to the Elder of Rito Village, talk to Teba's wife in the next building who will point out the landing platform. This will trigger Link's memory of the champion Revali.

title: Daruk's Mettle
description: This memory - not attached to Princess Zelda, can be obtained during the main quest - Divine Beast Vah Rudania. After speaking with the boss of the village, Bludo, he'll point out the large carving of the champion built into the walls above Goron City. Seeing this will trigger a memory of Link's time with the Goron Champion.

title: Urbosa's Hand
description: This memory - not attatched to Princess Zelda, can be found during the main quest - Divine Beast Vah Naboris. Once you've infiltrated Gerudo Town and spoken to the chief, Riju, get the Thunder Helm back from the Yiga Clan, and giving it back to Riju will trigger a memory of Link's time with the Gerudo Champion, Urbosa.

title: Mipha's Touch
description: This memory - not attached to Princess Zelda, is found during part of the Main Quest, Divine Beast Vah Ruta. After speaking with the Zora King, head down to the lower level to talk to Muzu, who will point out the statue of Mipha. Seeing it will cause Link to remember a memory of his time with Mipha, the Zora Champion.

title: The Master Sword
description: The last memory, while attached to Princess Zelda, has no picture in the Sheikah Slate album, and is instead part of the Main Quest - The Hero's Sword. Once you have located the Master Sword, you will need to successfully pull out the sword - which requires a minimum of 13 Heart Containers. Doing so will cause Link to see the final memory.

title: Watch Out for the Flowers
description: Requirements: None How to start: Speak with [Magda](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246603) Solution: Reach the entrance of the [Hila Rao Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225220) without stepping on the flowers; instead, navigate through the cleared areas. Stepping on a flower will reset Link's position to Magda. Reward: Unlocks the [Hila Rao Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225220).

title: The Stolen Heirloom
description: Requirements: - Find the Fairy Fountain - Flown the Coop - By Firefly's Light How to start: Speak with [Paya](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246614) Solution: 1. Wait until 22:00 by sitting at the bonfire outside. 2. Stealthily follow [Dorian](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246616) up to the [Lakna Rokee Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225156). 3. Defeat the [Yiga Blademaster](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225275). 4. Place the heirloom into the pedestal. Reward: Unlocks the [Lakna Rokee Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225156)

title: The Crowned Beast
description: Requirements: None How to start: Speak with [Kass](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246620) Solution: Find a [Mountain Buck](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?catIds=7772) and ride it to the pedestal near Kass. Reward: Unlocks the [Mezza Lo Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225160)

title: Secret of the Cedars
description: Requirements: None How to start: Speak with [Clavia](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246624) Solution: Head to [Tahno O'ah Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225263), and reveal it by bombing the cracked wall there. Reward: Unlocks the [Tahno O'ah Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225263).

title: The Spring of Wisdom
description: Requirements: None How to start: Speak with [Medda](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246628) Solution: 1. Go to the [Spring of Wisdom](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246489). 2. Shoot all 4 large Malice Eyes over Naydra's body. Use the nearby updrafts and high peaks to get different vantage points. 3. Shoot Naydra one last time. 4. Pick up Naydra's Scale, then drop it in the spring. Reward: Unlocks the [Jitan Sa'mi Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225256)

title: The Cursed Statue
description: Requirements: None How to start: Speak with [Calip](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246634) Solution: Go near [Kam Urog Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225161), and shoot an arrow at the statue with glowing eyes. Reward: Unlocks the [Kam Urog Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225161)

title: Master of the Wind
description: Requirements: None How to start: Speak with [Kass](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246652) Solution: Clear the large rock formation of the debris blocking the wind currents. There are 4 debris to blow up, using either bombs or Bomb arrows. Once cleared, climb on top of the formation and glide along the wind current onto the pedestal. Reward: Unlocks the [Shai Yota Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225169)

title: The Ceremonial Song
description: Requirements: None How to start: Speak with [Laruta](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246655) Solution: Retrieve the [Ceremonial Trident](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=245744). Then, go to [Veiled Falls](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246471). Gain some height, either by swimming up the waterfall or climbing a nearby cliff, and glide down towards the pedestal. Finally, when just above it, attack with the Trident to reveal the shrine. Reward: Unlocks the [Dagah Keek Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225163)

title: A Song of Storms
description: Requirements: None How to start: Speak with [Kass](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246661) Solution: Get lightning to strike the mound at the shrine. During a thunderstorm, you can: - Wear a metal weapon or armor, and get struck by lightning; - Wear the [Thunder Helm](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247295) to avoid taking damage; - Drop a metal weapon on top of mound. As lightning is about to strike, paraglide away to avoid damage. Reward: Unlocks the [Qukah Nata Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225249)

title: A Fragmented Monument
description: Requirements: None How to start: Speak with [Garini](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246665) Solution: Take pictures of the three lost fragments ([#1](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246667), [#2](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246668) and [#3](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246669)) and bring them back to Garini. Then, crouch on either pedestals to reveal the shrine. Reward: Unlocks the [Kah Yah Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225166)

title: The Three Giant Brothers
description: Requirements: None How to start: Read the stone tablet Solution: Bring the three glowing balls in the pedestals around the stone tablet. The balls are around the necks of the nearby Hinox brothers ([the youngest](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225309); [the middle](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225316); [the oldest](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225332)). You may either defeat them, or simple steal the balls. Reward: Unlocks the [Tawa Jinn Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225162)

title: Stranded on Eventide
description: Requirements: The ability to reach Eventide island (at least 2 stamina wheels to paraglide from [Cape Cales](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246509)) How to start: Step on [Eventide Island](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246547). Be careful; you will be stripped of all your gear, including your inventory. Solution: Bring the three glowing orbs ([#1](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246674), [#2](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246676), [#3](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246678)) to the three altars ([#1](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246675), [#2](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246677), [#3](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246679)), in any combination. Reward: Unlocks the [Korgu Chideh Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225170)

title: The Serpent's Jaws
description: Requirements: None How to start: Speak with [Kass](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246685) Solution: Drop a Farosh's Scale in the [Spring of Courage](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246282). Reward: Unlocks the [Shae Katha Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225224)

title: Guardian Slideshow
description: Requirements: None How to start: Speak with [Loone](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246693) Solution: Take pictures of a Guardian Stalker, a Guardian Skywatcher and a Guardian Scout. Use the "Search" bar to find each type of guardian. Then, take the Ancient Orb and place it on the pedestal. Reward: Unlocks the [Shoqa Tatone Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225155)

title: The Eye of the Sandstorm
description: Requirements: None How to start: Speak with [Nobiro](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246878) Solution: Go to the shrine between 9:00 PM and 4:00 AM. Reward: Unlocks the [Dako Tah Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225184)

title: Secret of the Snowy Peaks
description: Requirements: None How to start: Read the [Mountain Peak Log](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=239015) Solution: Grab the largest snowball in the nearby ponds. Then, stand at the edge of the cliff, facing the [Pedestal](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246889), between 16:30 and 17:30. The snowball should cast a shadow on the center of the pedestal, revealing the shrine. Reward: Unlocks the [Suma Sahma Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225148)

title: The Silent Swordswomen
description: Requirements: None How to start: Speak with [Laine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246892) Solution: Follow the trail of statues to the shrine. Reward: Unlocks the [Kema Zoos Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225176)

title: The Undefeated Champ
description: Requirements: None How to start: Speak with [Shabonne](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246895) Solution: Win [Sand-Seal Racing](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246896) under 1:30.00. Then, place the trophy in the pedestal to reveal the shrine. Reward: Unlocks the [Raqa Zunzo Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225138)

title: The Desert Labyrinth
description: Requirements: None How to start: Enter the [South Lomei Labyrinth](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246185) Solution: Reach the center of the maze; see the attached screenshot for the solution. Reward: Unlocks the [Dila Maag Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225205)

title: The Seven Heroines
description: Requirements: None How to start: Speak with [Rotana](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246908) Solution: Go to the [East Gerudo Ruins](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246141), and gather the six scattered Glowing Orbs ([#1](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246910), [#2](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246911), [#3](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246912), [#4](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246913), [#5](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246914), [#6](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246915)) in the center. Then, place the orbs in the pedestals, so their symbol matches the statue behind it. From the entrance, going clockwise, the order is: - Comma (,) - Carrot (^) - O - Colon (:) - S - Tear - II (already in place) Reward: Unlocks the [Korsh O'hu Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225144)

title: The Perfect Drink
description: Requirements: None How to start: Speak with [Pokki](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246917) Solution: Speak with [Furosa](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246919) about the drink, then speak with [Anshe](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246921) at the icehouse during the day. Finally, carry the block of ice from the icehouse to [Furosa](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246920) at the entrance of the ruins. Stay in the shade as much as possible. Reward: Unlocks the [Misae Suma Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225194)

title: Cliffside Etchings
description: Requirements: None How to start: Speak with [Geggle](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246927) Solution: At the shrine, shoot the pedestal with a Shock Arrow to reveal it. Reward: Unlocks the [Keeha Yoog Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225134)

title: Test of Will
description: Requirements: None How to start: Speak with [Bayge](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246931) Solution: The Gorons will challenge Link to two endurance challenges. The shrine will reveal itself after the second challenge. 1. Outlast the Gorons in Heat. Simply gain Heat Resistance or Flame Guard from food or equipment. 2. Outlast the Gorons in Heat and Fire, without equipment. This time, you need to gain Fireproof from a Fireproof Elixir. Otherwise, simply eat food as Link gets damaged until the Gorons pass out. Reward: Unlocks the [Joloo Nah Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225143)

title: Sign of the Shadow
description: Requirements: None How to start: Speak with [Kass](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246935) Solution: Stand on the pedestal in front of the shrine. At 15:00, the pedestal will light up; shoot an arrow at the sun to reveal the shrine. Reward: Unlocks the [Sasa Kai Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225135)

title: Trial of Thunder
description: Requirements: None How to start: Enter the [Thundra Plateau](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246123) Solution: Find the orbs scattered around the plateau ([Red Orb](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247008); [Green Orb](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247010); [Purple Orb](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247009); [Orange Orb](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247011)), and place them in the corresponding pedestals. Reward: Unlocks the [Toh Yahsa Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225141)

title: Under a Red Moon
description: Requirements: None How to start: Speak with [Kass](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247014) Solution: Stand on the pedestal during a Blood Moon, without any weapon or equipment, to reveal the shrine. Reward: Unlocks the [Mijah Rokee Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225142)

title: The Two Rings
description: Requirements: None How to start: Speak with [Kass](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247021) Solution: Move to this position, and shoot an arrow through both stone rings. See the screenshot for reference. Reward: Unlocks the [Sheem Dagoze Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225146)

title: The Ancient Rito Song
description: Requirements: [Divine Beast Vah Medoh](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248323) How to start: Speak with [Bedoli](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247031) Solution: Between 12:30 and 13:30, light a fire atop the pedestal just north of the shrine. Alternatively, stand on it with a lit torch. Reward: Unlocks the [Bareeda Naag Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225132)

title: Recital at Warbler's Nest
description: Requirements: Start [Find Kheel](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247039) How to start: Speak with [Kheel](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247040) Solution: 1. Find three of Kheel's sisters ([Notts](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247042), [Cree](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247044) and [Kotts](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247043)) and speak with them to get ingredients. 2. Head to the kitchen with [Genli](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247045) and cook him a Salmon Meunière with these ingredients. 3. Speak with [Kheel](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247040) to get a Korok Leaf. 4. From the pedestal, blow wind in the hand-shaped statues, in the following order, to reveal the shrine: - 4 fingers; - 5 fingers; - 3 fingers; - 1 finger; - 2 fingers; - The number of fingers corresponds to the positions of the singing Ritos during their song. Reward: Unlocks the [Voo Lota Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225133)

title: Trial on the Cliff
description: Requirements: None How to start: Enter the [North Lomei Labyrinth](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246186) Solution: Reach the center of the maze; see the attached screenshot for the solution, following the orange path and backtracking along the green path. Reward: Unlocks the [Qaza Tokki Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225206)

title: The Bird in the Mountains
description: Requirements: None How to start: Speak with [Molli](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247063) Solution: Head to the [Lone Cedar Tree](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247065). From there, paraglide towards the shrine; you should see it as you approach. Reward: Unlocks the [Mozo Shenno Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225179)

title: Shrouded Shrine
description: Requirements: None How to start: Walk to the marker. Solution: Use the torch to light up the bird statue, then follow the direction of its beak. Repeat this from statue to statue until you reach the [Blue Hinox](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225324). Get the orb from its neck (either defeat him or steal the orb), and place it in the [Pedestal](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247096) to reveal the shrine. Reward: Unlocks the [Ketoh Wawai Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225153)

title: The Lost Pilgrimage
description: Requirements: None How to start: Speak with [Tasho](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247100) Solution: Follow [Oaki](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247102) without him seeing you, all the way to the shrine. Stay at a distance and don't move when he turns around. Reward: Unlocks the [Daag Chokah Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225207)

title: Trial of Second Sight
description: Requirements: None How to start: Speak with [Zooki](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247104) Solution: 1. Using Magnesis, spot the trees holding iron in their branches. 2. Walk from tree to tree to lead you to the [Rusty Shield](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=245485). 3. Magnesis the shield in the tree behind the torches; doing so will spawn a [Treasure Chest containing Amber](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=244490). 4. Magnesis the chest on the nearby raft, grab a Korok Leaf and move it to the island in the center of the pond. 5. Drop the chest in the tree to spawn the shrine. Reward: Unlocks the [Kuhn Sidajj Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225154)

title: The Test of Wood
description: Requirements: None How to start: Speak with [Damia](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247107) Solution: Reach the shrine, using only the given pieces of equipment. If any break (by usage or contact with a Fire enemy) or dropped (by contact with an Electric enemy), the trial is failed. - [Forest Dweller's Sword](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=245899) - [Forest Dweller's Shield](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=245510) - [Forest Dweller's Bow](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=245097) Reward: Unlocks the [Maag Halan Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225217)

title: Into the Vortex
description: Requirements: None How to start: Read the stone slab. Solution: Carry the nearby orb all the way to the shrine. Reward: Unlocks the [Ritaag Zumo Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225167)

title: The Spring of Power
description: Requirements: None How to start: Speak with [Nobo](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247118) Solution: Interact with the statue at the [Spring of Power](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246449). Then, drop a Dinraal's Scale in the pond to reveal the shrine. Reward: Unlocks the [Tutsuwa Nima Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225251)

title: The Skull's Eye
description: Requirements: None How to start: Speak with [Jerrin](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247122) Solution: Simply get to the shrine. Climbing gear and high stamina are recommended. Reward: Unlocks the [Zuna Kai Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225250)

title: Trial of the Labyrinth
description: Requirements: None How to start: Set foot on [Lomei Labyrinth Island](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246516) Solution: Navigate to the center of the maze; see the attached screenshot for reference. Reward: Unlocks the [Tu Ka'loh Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225259)

title: A Brother's Roast
description: Requirements: None How to start: Speak with [Bladon](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247158) Solution: Speak with [Gonguron](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247160) in the tunnel. Then, bring him a [Rock Roast](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247161) to have him open the way to the shrine. Reward: Unlocks the [Kayra Mah Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225242)

title: The Gut Check Challenge
description: Requirements: None How to start: Speak with [Bayge](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247163) Solution: Complete the [Gut Check Rock Challenge](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247165), with a reduced entry fee of 20 Rupees. Reward: Unlocks the [Gorae Torr Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225240)

title: Find Kheel
description: Requirements: Divine Beast Vah Medoh How to start: Speak with [Amali](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247038) Walkthrough: Speak with [Kheel](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247040), then with Amali to complete the quest. Reward: Purple Rupee

title: A Landscape of a Stable
description: Requirements: None How to start: Speak with [Mayro](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247166) Solution: Reach the shrine to complete the quest. Reward: Unlocks the [Tah Muhl Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225245)

title: Misko, the Great Bandit
description: Requirements: None How to start: Speak to either [Prissen](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247169) or [Domidak](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247170) twice and pay them 100 Rupees. Walkthrough: Open any chest in [Misko's Cave](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247172) to complete the quest. Reward: The contents of the cave.

title: The Priceless Maracas
description: Requirements: None How to start: Speak with [Hestu](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247173) Walkthrough: Bring [Hestu's Maracas](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=243862) back to him. Reward: Unlocks Hestu's inventory upgrades.

title: Wild Horses
description: Requirements: None How to start: Speak with [Rensa](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247175) Walkthrough: Tame and bring a wild horse back to Rensa within 2 minutes. Look just north of the stable. Reward: Purple Rupee

title: Flown the Coop
description: Requirements: None How to start: Speak with [Cado](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247177) Walkthrough: Find the seven scattered Cuccos around the village and bring them back in the pen: - [Cucco #1](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=224224) - [Cucco #2](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=224225) - [Cucco #3](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=224226) - [Cucco #4](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=224227) - [Cucco #5](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=224230) - [Cucco #6](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=224232) - [Cucco #7](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=224233) Reward: Purple Rupee

title: Arrows of Burning Heat
description: Requirements: None How to start: Speak with [Rola](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=221290) Walkthrough: Using a bow, light all four torches surrounding the [Goddess Statue](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=245040). Use other torches or campfires to set normal arrows alight. Reward: Red Rupee

title: Koko's Kitchen
description: Requirements: None How to start: Speak with [Koko](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247180) Walkthrough: Bring Koko a Swift Carrot. If you have none, you can purchase one at [High Spirits Produce](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=221286). Reward: Hasty Veggie Cream Soup

title: Cooking with Koko
description: Requirements: [Koko's Kitchen](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247181) How to start: Speak with [Koko](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247180) Walkthrough: Bring Koko some Goat Butter. If you have none, you can purchase some at [High Spirits Produce](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=221286). Reward: Hot Buttered Apples

title: Koko Cuisine
description: Requirements: [Cooking with Koko](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247182) How to start: Speak with [Koko](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247180) Walkthrough: Bring Koko some Raw Meat. Reward: Tough Meat-Stuffed Pumpkin

title: Koko's Specialty
description: Requirements: [Koko Cuisine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247183) How to start: Speak with [Koko](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247180) Walkthrough: Bring Koko some Courser Bee Honey. If you have none, head to any large forest (such as the [Forest of Spirits](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246218)) and destroy a beehive. Reward: Energizing Honeyed Apple

title: Playtime with Cottla
description: Requirements: None How to start: Speak with [Cottla](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247185) between 11:00 and 17:00. Walkthrough: Depends on your choice of game: - Hide-and-seek: Wait for Cottla to hide, and go to [Cottla's Hiding Spot](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247187). - Tag: Run after Cottla, and sprint when near to her to catch her. Reward: Rock Salt

title: By Firefly's Light
description: Requirements: - Locked Mementos - Find the Fairy Fountain - [Flown the Coop](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247178) How to start: Speak with [Lasli](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247188), at night. Walkthrough: Bring five [Sunset Firefly](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?catIds=7833) and release them in Lasli's house. Reward: Purple Rupee

title: The Statue's Bargain
description: Requirements: None How to start: Speak with the [Horned Statue](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247190); you lose either a Heart Container or a Stamina Vessel upon doing so. Walkthrough: Speak with the statue again and choose to gain either a Heart Container or a Stamina Vessel to complete the quest. Reward: Horned Statue's exchange service.

title: The Weapon Connoisseur
description: Requirements: None How to start: Speak with [Nebb](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247192) Walkthrough: Show Nebb the weapon he seeks; he will give Link a reward and another weapon. Use the search bar on the left for the locations of a specific weapon. Weapons and rewards: - Traveler's Sword: Red Rupee - Fire Rod: Red Rupee - Moblin Club: Purple Rupee - Duplex Bow: Purple Rupee - Windcleaver: Silver Rupee - Ancient Battle Axe+: Silver Rupee - Frostspear: Gold Rupee - Ancient Short Sword: [Diamond](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247194)

title: A Gift for My Beloved
description: Requirements: None How to start: Speak with [Manny](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247195). Walkthrough: Speak with [Prima](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247197), then with Manny again. Bring him 10 [Restless Cricket](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?catIds=7832) to complete the quest. Reward: Silver Rupee

title: The Sheep Rustlers
description: Requirements: None How to start: Speak with [Koyin](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247198) Walkthrough: Complete the [Enemy Camp](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247200) at Hateno Beach. Reward: 10x Fresh Milk

title: Robbie's Research
description: Requirements: Locked Mementos How to start: Speak with [Purah](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247204) Walkthrough: 1. Head to the [Akkala Ancient Tech Lab](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247202). 2. Speak with [Cherry](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247201) inside. 3. Remove your body armor, then speak with Robbie. 4. Head to the [Ancient Furnace](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247206) with a Torch. Light it with the furnace's blue flame. 5. Bring the blue flame back to the lab. See the screenshot for a reference path. Light the stone lanterns along the way so you can safely drop the torch to fight if needed. 6. Light the brazier in front of the lab to complete the quest. Reward: Unlocks the Akkala Ancient Tech Lab's shop.

title: Slated for Upgrades
description: Requirements: Locked Mementos How to start: Speak with [Purah](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247204) Walkthrough: Upgrade the three following runes in your Sheikah slate: - Stasis → Stasis+ (3x Ancient Core): Allows Stasis to also freeze enemies. - Remote Bomb → Remote Bomb+ (3x Ancient Shaft): Increses the blast radius while reducing the cooldown. - Sheikah Sensor → Sheikah Sensor+ (3x Ancient Screw): Allows the Sensor to track Compendium items instead of Ancient Shrines. Reward: The above rune upgrades.

title: Sunshroom Sensing
description: Requirements: Sheikah Sensor+ (acquired during [Slated for Upgrades](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247218)) How to start: Speak with [Symin](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247219) Walkthrough: Bring Symin a picture of a Sunshroom (she suggests [this one](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=230628)). Then, using the Sensor+, find three more [Sunshroom](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?catIds=6888) and bring them to Symin. Reward: 3x Hearty Truffle

title: The Hero's Cache
description: Requirements: None How to start: Speak with [Kass](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247221) Walkthrough: Grab the [Treasure Chest](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=244205) from the water and open it to complete the quest. Reward: The Gold Rupee inside the chest.

title: Hylian Homeowner
description: Requirements: None How to start: Speak with [Bolson](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247223) Walkthrough: Gather 30 bundles of wood (use axes or bombs on fell trees) and 3,000 Rupees and give them to Bolson. Speak to [Hudson](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247225) to start [From the Ground Up](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247226), then speak with Bolson again. Finally, purchase all 14 available house upgrades at 100 Rupees apiece to complete the quest: - Gear displays (store a piece of gear ouside of Link's inventory): - 2x Weapon display - 3x Bow display - 3x Shield display - Bed (heals Link while passing time) - Cosmetics: Door, Lighting, Sign with Link's Name, Flowers and Trees. Reward: The house.

title: From the Ground Up
description: Requirements: Link's House (acquired during [Hylian Homeowner](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247224)) How to start: Speak with [Hudson](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247225) Walkthrough: 1. Speak with [Hudson](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247227) in the Akkala region. 2. Hudson will first ask for some bundles of wood, then for a specific individual. Speak to that individual to bring them to the village, which will unlock a new building. Do this process four times: - Bring 10 bundles of wood, then get [Greyson](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247421) to open [Ore and More](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247422) - Bring 20 bundles of wood, then get [Rhondson](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247427) to open [Rhondson Armor Boutique](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247428) - Bring 30 bundles of wood, then get [Fyson](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247424) to open [Slippery Falcon (Tarrey Town Branch)](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247425) - Bring 50 bundles of wood, then get [Kapson](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247430) to open [Tarrey Town Inn](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247431) 3. Speak with Hudson, then speak [Bolson](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247223) and head back to Tarrey Town. 4. After the cutscene, speak with Hudson to complete the quest. Reward: [3x Diamond](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247228)

title: Special Delivery
description: Requirements: Divine Beast Vah Ruta How to start: Speak with [Finley](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247229) Walkthrough: Follow and guard the container down the river, all the way to [Sasan](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247231). Stay a little ahead to clear any enemies or obstacles in the way. Speak with Sasan, then with [Finley](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247233) in Zora's Domain to complete the quest. Reward: [Gold Rupee](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247234)

title: Diving is Beauty!
description: Requirements: Divine Beast Vah Ruta How to start: Speak with [Gruve](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247235) Walkthrough: Jump down the waterfall to dive in the basin below. Then, swim up the waterfall and speak with Gruve to complete the shrine. Reward: 5x Fleet-Lotus Seeds

title: Lynel Safari
description: Requirements: - Divine Beast Vah Ruta - Locked Mementos How to start: Speak with [Laflat](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247237) Walkthrough: Show Laflat the picture of any [Lynel](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?catIds=6846). Reward: [Zora Greaves](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247239)

title: Frog Catching
description: Requirements: Divine Beast Vah Ruta How to start: Speak with [Tumbo](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247240) Walkthrough: Bring him five [Hot-Footed Frogs](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?catIds=7834) to complete the quest. Reward: Armoranth

title: The Giant of Ralis Pond
description: Requirements: Divine Beast Vah Ruta How to start: Speak with [Torfeau](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247242) Walkthrough: Defeat the [Blue Hinox](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225326) by Ralis Pond, then speak with Torfeau to complete the quest. Reward: Silver Rupee

title: Luminous Stone Gathering
description: Requirements: Divine Beast Vah Ruta How to start: Speak with [Ledo](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247244) Walkthrough: Bring him 10 [Luminous Stone](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?catIds=6873) to complete the quest. Reward: [2x Diamond](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247246), and the ability to trade Luminous Stone for Diamonds with Ledo.

title: A Wife Washed Away
description: Requirements: Divine Beast Vah Ruta How to start: Speak with [Fronk](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247247) Walkthrough: Speak with [Mei](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247249) to complete the quest. Reward: 5x Staminoka Bass

title: Riverbed Reward
description: Requirements: None How to start: Speak with [Izra](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247250) Walkthrough: Grab the [Treasure Chest](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=244468) from the river and speak with Izra to complete the quest. Reward: The Knight's Broadsword inside.

title: Zora Stone Monuments
description: Requirements: Divine Beast Vah Ruta How to start: Speak with [Jiahto](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247252) Walkthrough: Read all 10 [Zora Monuments](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?catIds=6860) in any order, then speak with Jiahto to complete the quest. Reward: [Diamond](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247254)

title: What's for Dinner?
description: Requirements: None How to start: Speak with Kiana Walkthrough: Bring her some Goat Butter (purchasable at [High Spirits Produce](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=221286) and a Hearty Blueshell Snail ([this one](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=222910) is fairly close). Reward: - Purple Rupee - Seafood Paella

title: Sunken Treasure
description: Requirements: None How to start: Speak with [Rozel](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247257) Walkthrough: Open all four of the chests below and speak with Rozel again to complete the quest. Reward: - [Topaz](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=243958) - [Topaz](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=243959) - [Sapphire](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=243935) - [Thunderblade](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=244480)

title: Take Back the Sea
description: Requirements: None How to start: Speak with [Sebasto](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247259) Walkthrough: Complete the [Enemy Camp](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247261) near [Aris Beach](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246375), then speak with Sebasto to complete the quest. Reward: Silver Rupee

title: A Gift of Nightshade
description: Requirements: None How to start: Speak with [Wabbin](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247262) Walkthrough: Bring a [Blue Nightshade](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?catIds=6878) to [Perda](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247263). Reward: Red Rupee + Purple Rupee

title: Thunder Magnet
description: Requirements: None How to start: Speak with [Cima](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247265) Walkthrough: Climb the side of the stable and remove the [Woodcutter's Axe](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=245340) from the roof. Reward: [Rubber Helm](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247267)

title: Hunt for the Giant Horse
description: Requirements: None How to start: Speak with [Straia](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247268) Walkthrough: Capture the [Giant Horse](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225912) and bring it back to Straia. Reward: Silver Rupee

title: The Horseback Hoodlums
description: Requirements: None How to start: Speak with [Perosa](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247270) Walkthrough: Defeat 5 Blue Bokoblins on horseback; five such enemies wander just north, in the [Fural Plain](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246293). Speak with Perosa again to complete the quest. Reward: 1x Endura Carrot

title: Good-Sized Horse
description: Requirements: None How to start: Speak with [Zyle](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247272) Walkthrough: Bring Zyle any normal-sized horse. Reward: Gold Rupee

title: Missing in Action
description: Requirements: None How to start: Speak with [Sesami](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=237727) Walkthrough: Save [Flaxel](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=237730), [Canolo](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=237728), [Oliff](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=237734) and [Palme](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=237732) from the Bokoblin. The four of them are on the wooden scaffoldings; either access from the cliffs around or from the start of the ramp, under Flaxel. Reward: Gold Rupee

title: Rushroom Rush!
description: Requirements: None How to start: Speak with [Pirou](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247277) Walkthrough: Bring Pirou 55 [Rushroom](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?catIds=6886) to complete the shrine. Reward: [Diamond](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=244843)

title: An Ice Guy
description: Requirements: None How to start: Speak with [Guy](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247280) Walkthrough: Bring Guy a Chilly Elixir. Do to so, mix any monster part with either a Winterwing Butterfly or a Cold Darner in a Cooking Pot. Reward: Purple Rupee

title: Tools of the Trade
description: Requirements: Forbidden City Entry How to start: Speak with [Isha](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247282) Walkthrough: Bring her 10 Flint to complete the quest Reward: - One of either the [Sapphire Circlet](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247392), the [Ruby Circlet](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247391) or the [Topaz Earrings](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247396) for free; - Access to [Starlight Memories](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247390)

title: The Secret Club's Secret
description: Requirements: Forbidden City Entry How to start: Try a code the at Gerudo Secret Club's door. Walkthrough: Speak with either [Yaido](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247285), [Sumati](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247286) or [Pyra](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247287). Then, head to the building directly southwest and eavesdrop on them through the window. Try the right code (GSC◆) at the door to complete the quest. Reward: Access to [Gerudo Secret Club](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247389)

title: Medicinal Molduga
description: Requirements: Forbidden City Entry How to start: Speak with [Malena](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247288) Walkthrough: Bring Malena some Molduga Guts, which are obtained by killing a Molduga. Reward: Gold Rupee

title: The Eighth Heroine
description: Requirements: Forbidden City Entry How to start: Speak with [Bozai](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247290) while wearing the Gerudo Set. Walkthrough: Head to the [Statue of the Eighth Heroine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246044), and take picture of its head. Show it to Bozai to complete the quest. Reward: [Sand Boots](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247292)

title: The Forgotten Sword
description: Requirements: [The Eighth Heroine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247291) How to start: Speak with [Bozai](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247290) Walkthrough: Take a picture of the giant stone sword atop [Gerudo Summit](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246058), and show it to Bozai to complete the quest. Reward: ??

title: The Thunder Helm
description: Requirements: Divine Beast Vah Naboris How to start: Interact with the [Thunder Helm](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247295) Walkthrough: Complete the four following side quests, then speak with [Riju](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247297). - [Tools of the Trade](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247283) - [Medicinal Molduga](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247289) - [The Mystery Polluter](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247299) - [The Search for Barta](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247302) Reward: [Thunder Helm](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247295)

title: The Mystery Polluter
description: Requirements: - Divine Beast Vah Naboris - Start [The Thunder Helm](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247296) How to start: Speak with [Dalia](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247298) around noon. Walkthrough: Speak with [Calyban](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247300), then bring her 10 [Wildberry](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?catIds=7745). Speak with Dalia to complete the quest. Reward: - 1x Hydromelon - Wildberry bushes

title: The Search for Barta
description: Requirements: - Divine Beast Vah Naboris - Start [The Thunder Helm](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247296) How to start: Speak with [Liana](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247301) Walkthrough: Bring a Hearty Durian to [Barta](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247303), then speak with Liana to complete the quest. Reward: Silver Rupee

title: Curry for What Ails You
description: Requirements: None How to start: Speak with [Lester](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247304) Walkthrough: Bring Lester some Goron Spice, which you can get from [Goron Gusto Shop](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247378) Reward: Purple Rupee

title: The Apple of my Eye
description: Requirements: None How to start: Speak with [Juney](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246590) Walkthrough: Bring a Baked Apple (an apple thrown on a campfire) to Juney to complete the quest. Reward: Silver Rupee

title: The Spark of Romance
description: Requirements: None How to start: Speak with [Jogo](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246589) Walkthrough: Bring a piece of Flint to Jogo to complete the quest. Reward: Silver Rupee

title: Face the Frost Talus
description: Requirements: Divine Beast Vah Medoh How to start: Speak with [Gesane](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247308) Walkthrough: Defeat the [Frost Talus](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225346) and return to Gesane to complete the quest. Reward: Silver Rupee

title: Stalhorse: Pictured!
description: Requirements: Locked Mementos How to start: Speak with [Juannelle](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247310) Walkthrough: Bring Juannelle a picture of either [Stalhorse](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225913)/[Stalhorse](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225914) to complete the quest. Reward: Silver Rupee

title: Balloon Flight
description: Requirements: None How to start: Speak with [Shamae](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247312) Walkthrough: Use 2 Octo Balloons (drops from Octoroks) on the barrel to make it fly and complete the quest. Reward: 1x Star Fragment

title: A Freezing Rod
description: Requirements: Start The Hero's Sword How to start: Speak with [Kula](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247314) Walkthrough: Bring back either an Ice Rod or a Blizzard Rod to Kula to complete the quest. Reward: Silver Rupee (for an Ice Rod) or Gold Rupee (for a Blizzard Rod)

title: The Korok Trials
description: Requirements: Start The Hero's Sword How to start: Speak with [Chio](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247316) Walkthrough: Complete the following three Shrine Quests: - [Trial of Second Sight](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247105) - [The Lost Pilgrimage](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247101) - [The Trial of Wood](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247108) Reward: 3x Hearty Truffle

title: Legendary Rabbit Trial
description: Requirements: - Locked Mementos - Start The Hero's Sword - Start [The Priceless Maracas](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247174) How to start: Speak with [Peeks](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247318) Walkthrough: Bring Peeks a picture of a [Blupee](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?catIds=6835) to complete the quest. Reward: Silver Rupee

title: Leviathan Bones
description: Requirements: Locked Mementos How to start: Speak with either [Akrah](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247320), [Onya](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247323) or [Garshon](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247322) Walkthrough: Show each brother the picture he wants to see: - Show Garshon a picture of the [Gerudo Great Skeleton](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246046); - Show Onya a picture of the [Hebra Great Skeleton](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246048); - Show Akrah a picture of the [Eldin Great Skeleton](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246306); Reward: Gold Rupee

title: A Gift from the Monks
description: Requirements: Complete the 120 non-DLC shrines How to start: Automatic upon completion of the last shrine Walkthrough: Open the three following chests to complete the quest. Reward: - [Cap of the Wild](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=244840) - [Tunic of the Wild](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=244842) - [Trousers of the Wild](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=244841)

title: Riddles of Hyrule
description: Requirements: Start The Hero's Sword How to start: Speak with [Walton](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247325) Walkthrough: Solve each of the five riddles by dropping its answer on the leaf. You may pick up the item afterwards. The answers are: - Apple; - Fortified Pumpkin; - Sunshroom; - Voltfin Trout; - Lynel Hoof; Reward: [Diamond](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247327)

title: A Gift for the Great Fairy
description: Requirements: None How to start: Speak with [Toren](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247328) Walkthrough: Speak with [Great Fairy Kayasa](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246037), then speak with Toren again to complete the shrine. Reward: 500 Rupees

title: The Royal Guard's Gear
description: Requirements: None How to start: Speak with [Parcy](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247330) Walkthrough: Show Parcy any Royal Guard weapon, or a Royal Guard Shield, to complete the quest. Use the search bar on the left to see their locations. Reward: Gold Rupee

title: A Rare Find
description: Requirements: None How to start: Speak with [Trott](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247332) Walkthrough: Bring Trott a piece of Raw Gourmet Meat. Most mammals have about 10% chance to drop some; see individual categories for specific drop rates and categories. Reward: Silver Rupee

title: My Hero
description: Requirements: None How to start: Speak with [Aliza](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247335) Walkthrough: Complete The Hero's Sword and show Aliza the [Master Sword](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246013) to complete the quest. Reward: 1x Star Fragment

title: A Royal Recipe
description: Requirements: None How to start: Speak with [Gotter](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247337) Walkthrough: Make Gotter either of the recipes found in Hyrule Castle's Library. You do not have to read the recipes, you can just make them: - [Fruitcake](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=245056): Fruit, Fruit, Tabantha Wheat, Cane Sugar - [Monster Cake](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=245057): Monster Extract, Tabantha Wheat, Cane Sugar, Goat Butter Reward: Silver Rupee. If you make the other recipe, you will gain another Silver Rupee.

title: The Royal White Stallion
description: Requirements: None How to start: Speak with [Toffa](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247339) Walkthrough: Bring the [White Horse](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225916) to Toffa. Reward: - [Royal Saddle](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247341) - [Royal Bridle](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247342)

title: Fireproof Lizard Roundup
description: Requirements: None How to start: Speak with [Kima](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247343) Walkthrough: Bring 10 [Fireproof Lizard](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?catIds=7838) to Kima to complete the quest. Reward: [Flamebreaker Armor](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247345)

title: The Road to Respect
description: Requirements: None How to start: Speak with [Fugo](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247346) Walkthrough: Defeat the [Igneo Talus](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225339) near [Darunia Lake](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246309) to complete the quest. Reward: Silver Rupee

title: Death Mountain's Secret
description: Requirements: None How to start: Speak with [Dugby](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247348) Walkthrough: Show the [Drillshaft](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=245729) to Dugby to complete the quest. Reward: The Drillshaft.

title: The Jewel Trade
description: Requirements: Divine Beast Vah Rudania How to start: Speak with [Ramella](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247350) Walkthrough: Bring 10 Amber to Ramella to complete the quest. Reward: 500 Rupees

title: A Parent's Love
description: Requirements: [From the Ground Up](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247226) How to start: Eavesdrop a conversation between [Ruli](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247352) and [Hagie](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247354) from their window, around 21:00. Walkthrough: Give a Monster Cake (Monster Extract, Tabantha Wheat, Goat Butter, Cane Sugar) to Ruli, then speak her again to complete the quest. Reward: Gold Rupee

title: Hobbies of the Rich
description: Requirements: [From the Ground Up](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247226) How to start: Speak with [Hagie](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247354) Walkthrough: Defeat both Guardian Stalkers in the [Torin Wetlands](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246455) ([here](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225686) and [here](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225687)) Reward: Silver Rupee + Red Rupee

title: A Shady Customer
description: Requirements: Locked Mementos How to start: Speak with [Hoz](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247356) Walkthrough: Show Hoz a picture of Kilton, the owner of Fang and Bone. Reward: Silver Rupee

title: Little Sister's Big Request
description: Requirements: None How to start: Give an Armoranth to [Jana](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247358) Walkthrough: Speak with [Gleema](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247360), then bring Jana a Warm Darner, a Cold Darner and an Electric Darner. Then, speak to Gleema, then Jana to complete the quest. Reward: Silver Rupee

title: EX Royal Guard Rumors
description: Requirements: Complete [The Isolated Plateau](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248304) How to start: Automatic Walkthrough: Read [Super Rumor Mill V4](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=245067), then open the chests in the rewards to complete the quest. Reward: - [Royal Guard Cap](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=244520) - [Royal Guard Uniform](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=244522) - [Royal Guard Boots](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=244521) Note: Part of the Expansion Pass DLC

title: EX Ancient Horse Rumors
description: Requirements: Champions' Ballad DLC How to start: Find the new journal - Super Rumor Mill EX: Volume 3 - inside the Highland Stable. Walkthrough: You can find the Ancient Bridle at the base of the large tree at the top of Satori Mountain - look for the distinctive pink petals that adorn the tree and surround the ground. Use Magnesis to pull the embedded chest out of the ground to claim it. Reward: Ancient Bridle

title: EX Treasure: Merchant Hood
description: Requirements: Champions' Ballad DLC How to start: The Quest is located at the Deya Village Ruins, located in the Lake Region to the Southwest of the Dueling Peaks Tower. Walkthrough: Find the clue and then travel to the Spring of Courage where Shae Katha Shrine is found. Climb up the platform that the stone claw is clutching and look under the claws with the Magnesis Rune to find a buried chest holding Ravio's Hood. Reward: Ravio's Hood

title: EX Treasure: Usurper King
description: Requirements: Champions' Ballad How to start: Travel to the flooded ruins of the Deya Village and look for a large destroyed house with its foundation intact - near a broken wagon. Inside the house is a new journal from Misko the Great Bandit. Walkthrough: Head to Tobio's Hollow, to the South of the Dueling Peaks where a Hinox sleeps. North of this valley is a swampy pool - and if you carefully glide down to the island in the top left, you can find a buried chest containing Zant's Helmet. Reward: Zant's Helmet

title: EX Treasure: Garb of the Winds
description: Requirements: Champions' Ballad DLC How to start: Travel to the flooded ruins of the Deya Village and look for a large destroyed house with its foundation intact - near a broken wagon. Inside the house is a new journal from Misko the Great Bandit. Walkthrough: Head to Cora Lake, and look at the motion of the water to find where the source is coming from off on the West. Once you get to the last few rocks in front of the source, use Magnesis to check the waters below to find the chest holding the Island Lobster Shirt (create a platform with Cryonis to get close to the chest). Reward: Island Lobster Shirt

title: EX Treasure: Dark Armor
description: Requirements: Champions' Ballad DLC How to start: Travel to the flooded ruins of the Deya Village and look for a large destroyed house with its foundation intact - near a broken wagon. Walkthrough: To find the chest piece, head to the Faron Tower, and glide down to the West towards the Sarjon Woods. Make for the Sarjon Bridge between the two small waterfalls. Jump onto the rocks under the bridge and use Magnesis to pull a chest up containing the Phantom Ganon Armor. Reward: Phantom Ganon armor set

title: EX Strange Mask Rumors
description: Requirements: Master Trials DLC How to start: Start by heading over to the Woodland Stable at the southeast corner of the Great Hyrule Forest region near Mirro Shaz Shrine. Inside the stable, there is an open book with the clues. Walkthrough: Enter the Lost Woods through the entrance in the southeast, north of Woodland Tower. Follow the torches as you would normally until you reach the area with the final two torches. Take note of the embers and which way the wind blows them which is the direction you will need to run towards. In order to get the Korok Mask you just need to keep running in the same direction from the two torches, even when the wind changes. This will lead you to a tree where you can use Magnesis to pull out the special chest with the Korok Mask inside. Reward: Korok Mask

title: EX Teleportation Rumors!
description: Requirements: Master Trials DLC How to start: Head to South Akkala Stable near Ze Kasho Shrine, northwest of Akkala Tower and look for an open book on the table inside the stable. Walkthrough: Head to the Tu Ka'loh Shrine. Inside, run to the far end of the room towards the back wall to find the treasure chest containing the Travel Medallion. Reward: Travel Medallion

title: EX Treasure: Ancient Mask
description: Requirements: Master Trials DLC How to start: Warp to the Great Plateau Tower and paraglide east to Outpost Ruins. Head for the southernmost walls. Walkthrough: Lake Kolomo is found north of the Great Plateau Tower in the Central Hyrule Region. Nearby are the Kolomo Garrsion Ruins on the southeast edge of Lake Kolomo. Outside the walls is a small heap of rubble. Use Magnesis to pull the treasure chest out of the ground containing Majora's Mask. Reward: Majora's Mask

title: EX Treasure: Fairy Clothes
description: Requirements: Master Trials DLC How to start: Warp to the Great Plateau Tower and paraglide east to Outpost Ruins. Head for the southern most walls. Walkthrough: This leads Link to Exchange Ruins, southeast of Kaam Ya'tak Shrine and northwest of Lake Kolomo. Once you get there, look for a pile of rubble on the east side of the ruins and use Magnesis to dredge up the treasure chest. Inside you'll find Tingle's Hood.
