The second clue leads Link to Castle Town Prison, an island west of Hyrule Castle and north of Moat Bridge. Look around the path with several burned wooden posts and use Magnesis to pull out a treasure chest from the rubble to get the Tingle's Shirt. The third clue leads Link to Mabe Village Ruins, west of the Ranch Ruins and east of the Central Tower. Once at the ruins, look for the rusted remains of a Guardian and use Magnesis to lift the treasure chest from under it. Inside are the nice and tight Tingle's Tights. Reward: Tingle's Hood, Tingle's Shirt, Tingle's Tights

title: EX Treasure: Twilight Relic
description: Requirements: Master Trials DLC How to start: Warp to the Great Plateau Tower and paraglide east to Outpost Ruins. Head for the southern most walls. Walkthrough: This clue leads Link to Sage Temple Ruins, west of Giant's Forest and east of Satori Mountain in northwest Central Hyrule. Travel to the Central Hyrule Tower and you'll be able to glide northwest, but watch out for Guardians at the foot of the tower. Once there, head over to the western most building where you'll find a pile of rubble in the shallow water. Beside the sword and shield is a treasure chest stuck in the ground. Use Magnesis to squeeze the chest out, then open it to find the fabled Midna's Helmet. Reward: Midna's Helmet

title: EX Treasure: Phantasma
description: Requirements: Master Trials DLC How to start: Warp to the Great Plateau Tower and paraglide east to Outpost Ruins. Head for the southern most walls. Walkthrough: This clue leads Link to the Coliseum Ruins, north of the Great Plateau and south of the Mount Daphnes. You'll need to enter and defeat (or avoid) the Lynel inside, then look along the northwest walls of the ground floor and use Magnesis on the buried chest to find the Phantom Helmet. You'll find the next item in the Sacred Ground Ruins, south of Hyrule Castle Town Ruins and northwest of Mabe Village Ruins. Once at the ruins, check the middle ring of water along the southeast side to use Magnesis to pull the chest out of the rubble. Inside you'll find the Phantom Armor. The last item is in the Hyrule Garrison Ruins, east of Mount Daphnes and north of Windvane Meadow. Look for a rusted Guardian on the eastern edge of the ruins and use Magnesis on the chest below it to find the Phantom Greaves. Reward: Phantom Helmet, Phantom Armor, Phantom Greaves

title: Trial of the Sword
description: Requirements: Master Trials DLC How to start: The Trial of the Sword is hidden inside the Lost Woods, in the very pedestal that the Master Sword sleeps in. This means you can only take on the trial when you have successfully found and obtained the Master Sword. Walkthrough: ?? Reward: ??

title: The Old Man's Diary
description: Location: In the ramshackled house. Contents: _Initial:_ On this desolate plateau, the only pleasure that brings me comfort is cooking. And today, I outdid myself! Truly, I created the perfect dish. I call it... spicy meat and seafood fry. This recipe not only restores health, but it also keeps me warm, even when traveling in the snowy mountains. With this dish on my side, I no longer have need of that itchy warm doublet. I do not know how I allowed this to happen, but it seems I forgot to write down a very important recipe. I know it contained raw meat and spicy peppers. However... I simply cannot remember what else I used! My age is catching up to me. Sadly, on this lonely plateau, I have only my own knowledge and memory to rely on. Still... If I did find someone who knew the missing ingredient, I would happily reward them with my warm doublet. However, it seems unlikely that such a miraculous wish will ever be fulfilled. _After showing the Old Man some Spicy Meat and Seafood Fry (Raw Meat, Spicy Pepper, Hyrule Bass)_: To my surprise and delight, I did happen upon someone who was able to re-create my spicy meat and seafood fry. I gave him my warm doublet, and I was happy to do so. He is a fine young man with great potential, that one. Ah, and I will now write down this perfect recipe so that I will never forget it. Place some raw meat, spicy pepper, and hyrule bass in a pot, and then turn up the heat. Voilà! Eating this dish allows you to walk the snowy mountains with ease, though I did forget there's a time limit on the effect. It is too bad I already gave away that warm doublet, which keeps you warm no matter how long you wear it. _After completing [The Isolated Plateau](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248304):_ Link... Bit by bit, you may come to realize who I am. I am sorry for not revealing my true identity to you sooner. The truth is, after you awoke from your long Slumber of Restoration, I did not know how to tell you all there was to say. Perhaps deceiving you was not the right thing to do. Still...you must admit I put on a great performance! But all joking aside...what I ask of you is of the utmost importance, dear hero. I implore you, with all my heart... defeat Calamity Ganon and save my precious daughter, Zelda. I understand this is no simple task I am asking of you, but I know beyond a shadow of a doubt that you can do it. I do not doubt it for a moment. I see courage in your eyes, just as I did 100 years ago. I believe in you, Link.

title: Misa's Recipe Book
description: Location: On a table, inside [The Slippery Falcon](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246584). Contents: Recipes to the following meals: - _Apple pie:_ Tabantha Wheat + Goat Butter + Cane Sugar + Apple - _Nutcake:_ Tabantha Wheat + Goat Butter + Cane Sugar + Nut (Acorn or Chickaloo Tree Nut) - _Fried Bananas:_ Tabantha Wheat + Cane Sugar + Mighty Bananas

title: Super Rumor Mill V4
description: Location: On a table, inside the stable. Contents: From the moment I wake to the moment I sleep, my mind is full of rumors. Even my dreams are gossipy! Traysi here! You fine folks keep up with dream rumors too, don't you? Well, this one's so good it might as well be a dream. Listen up, history buffs! This tidbit is about the brave soldiers who were tragically wiped out during the Great Calamity. The royal guards who protected the royal family! Amongst Hyrule's soldiers, only the best of the best had the honor of guarding the royal family. Apparently, the equipment they wore can still be found somewhere in Hyrule Castle. They say a former maid spoke of treasure [near the Dining Hall](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=244522), in [the Guards' Chamber](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=244521), and on [the second floor](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=244520). I do hope one day Hyrule Castle is restored to its former glory, complete with royal guards. Hmm... I wonder when a royal guard in shining armor will come sweep me off MY feet... Traysi's Recommendation: ★★★★★ [5 stars]
